jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Analytics Engineer

The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.

Our current data platform includes:

  • Ingestion: Stitch

  • Data warehouse: BigQuery

  • Transformation: dbt Cloud

  • Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight


What you’ll do

  • Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.

  • Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.

  • Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.

  • Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

  • AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

  • Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table.

Working with AI

AI is part of how we work every day and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye.

The Team

You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max, Data Insights, as part of our small Data team on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. 


Who you are

  • You have owned analytics engineering work end-to-end.

  • You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core).

  • You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec.

  • You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language.

  • You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce.

  • You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled.

  • You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering.

How we hire

There are three stages:

  • 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

  • 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task.

  • 30-minute conversation with a member of the Exec team.

What we have for you

Competitive compensation  

  • 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked in the Summer months when team targets are met

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact  

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.  
     

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

 

Here’s what our users say:  

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★  

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★  

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Senior HR Business Partner

Talk360 connects people across 190 countries. Every day, millions rely on us to reach family, friends, customers, colleagues. We're profitable and entering new markets, but we're not planning significant headcount growth.

Right now, we're a team of 35 people spread globally. Small enough to know each other's names, big enough to have real impact. As we grow, everything changes. How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally.

Your Goal: Own the Full Employee Journey

As our Senior HR Business Partner, you'll take everything we've built so far and make it your own. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here. 

You will:

  • Run the full employee lifecycle end-to-end: attraction, recruitment (with budget for external support on specialised roles), onboarding, development, performance, engagement and offboarding.

  • Be the go-to person for managers and employees on any people-related question, big or small

  • Keep our career growth framework relevant as the organisation evolves

  • Make sure our salaries stay fair and aligned with the market

  • Keep us compliant, without slowing us down

  • Be a genuine sounding board for the CEO and the Executive Team on people topics

  • Own internal communication. Make sure everyone understands where we're going, why, and what it means for them and their team 

  • Turn signals from the organisation into clear input for the Executive Team

Shape how it feels to work here

Talk360 is doing well, and we want that to show in how it feels to work here. You will:

  • Organise the team activities, outings and moments that make people want to stick around, and genuinely enjoy doing it

  • Bring energy to the day-to-day, not just to the big projects

Team

You're the only HR person and you report straight to the CEO, which means People & Culture has genuine influence on how we build this company.

We have an international diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond. You'll work closely with everyone, from support to product to leadership, and you'll actually see your impact as we grow and mature.


What you bring

  • 5+ years of HR experience across the full employee lifecycle, ideally in a start-up or scale-up. You've either been there and done that and want to do it again at a purpose-driven company, or you're a fast-growing medior who is ready to grow as fast as we do 

  • Comfortable running day-to-day HR operations as well as owning larger, more complex projects

  • Recruitment experience/exposure 

  • Experience with career frameworks, compensation benchmarking (we use Figures) is a plus

  • High energy and a genuine interest in creating a great place to work

  • Business acumen, you understand you are helping us to create a high-performing organization

  • Strong internal communication skills: you can make complex things clear, in writing and in person, for a multicultural audience 

Who you are

  • Not afraid to challenge the status quo, including challenging the Executive Team

  • As happy organising a team outing as solving a tricky HR cases

  • A trusted sparring partner for managers and employees

  • Curious, hands-on and pragmatic

  • Comfortable working with a multicultural hybrid team setup across time zones
     

What you get

Competitive compensation

  • 65,000 – 85,000 gross per year, all in.  

  • Option to work 32 hours a week.

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

  • 25 vacation days 

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

  • Regular team moments and outings 

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Account Executive

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Switzerland.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.


Accountabilities

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

  • New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

  • Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with pre-sales, forward-deployment, and engineering teams to coordinate customer test cases and pilot deployments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Pipeline Management and Forecasting: Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline, targeting at least four times quota coverage while providing clear forecasts and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

  • Regional Market Development: Represent the business across EMEA, regularly traveling to strategic customer locations and partner organizations to develop relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of experience in enterprise software sales, ideally as a major account manager or enterprise account executive within the semiconductor or electronics industry.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas of $2 million or more and closing complex, high-value deals ranging from six to seven figures.

  • Strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, fabless and Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) business models, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D IC.

  • Established network of senior decision-makers and industry contacts within major semiconductor, electronics, or engineering organizations across EMEA.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial value propositions to VP-level and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to discuss physics simulation concepts and their applications in design, validation, and manufacturing workflows without relying on sales engineers for every customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated experience selling through and managing partner ecosystems, including resellers, distributors, service providers, or other channel relationships.

  • Strong strategic account planning, prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, build relationships from the ground up, and create demand in markets where product categories and purchasing budgets may not yet be established.

  • Experience with consultative, challenger, and value-based selling methodologies, ideally supported by MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or Force Management frameworks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Academic or professional background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Previous Account Executive or enterprise sales experience at a leading EDA or engineering software company, such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Ansys.

  • Experience working for a high-growth AI or deep-tech startup focused on engineering applications.

  • Existing relationships with senior executives and decision-makers at major semiconductor companies across EMEA.

  • Proven success implementing land-and-expand strategies within large, complex, and highly specialized engineering organizations.

  • Experience establishing and scaling strategic channel and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong evangelistic selling skills, with the ability to educate customers, challenge established practices, and introduce innovative technology solutions.

    • Benefits:

  • Opportunity to help define the future of AI-powered hardware design and engineering.

  • Ownership of commercial strategy and enterprise relationships with influential semiconductor organizations worldwide.

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, physics simulation, and advanced engineering.

  • Opportunity to develop and lead a strategic international sales territory across EMEA.

  • Close collaboration with highly skilled engineers, researchers, and commercial professionals.

  • Dynamic, fast-paced startup environment offering significant autonomy and professional responsibility.

  • Opportunity to influence product direction, market positioning, and the development of an emerging technology category.

  • Career development potential within an innovative and rapidly growing technology business.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description:
Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment

Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge

Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.

Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.

We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch.

What You'll Do

Keep things running

  • Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks.

  • Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

  • Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most.

  • Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

  • Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute.


What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

  • Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

  • Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion.

  • Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills).

  • A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute.

  • You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks.

Nice to have

  • Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers.

  • Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost.

  • Experience with Omni dashboards.

Who You Are

  • Strategic and hands-on: You can think about where our payments set-up should go in the morning and fix a failing provider flow by lunch.

  • An owner: You pick up a seat that isn't yours after about two weeks of handover and run it without needing a brief, then hand it back in better shape than you found it.

  • Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess.

  • A bridge between teams: You work easily between Finance, Product, Support and external providers, and you explain things clearly in written English.

  • Invested in the person on the other end: You see a failed payment as someone who couldn't call home, and that makes you want to fix it properly.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Research EU/UK (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist - Research EU/UK (m/f/x)

Senior Data Scientist - Research (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Drive Applied AI Research & Model Development 

  • Research, develop, train, and fine-tune machine learning and LLM models to solve complex challenges within the manufacturing and product sustainability domain. 

  • Explore and evaluate new AI/ML methodologies, translating research and experimentation into practical, scalable solutions. 

  • Develop and optimise manufacturing, and compositional models to advance Makersite's core AI capabilities. 

Data Extraction & Pipeline Development 

  • Extract, consolidate, process, and contextualise complex data from customer ERP, PLM, and third-party databases to support AI model development. 

  • Design robust, reproducible, and extensible data pipelines to support model training, evaluation, and delivery. 

  • Address data quality, gaps, and complexity across both standardised and customer-specific AI use cases. 

Translate Research into Production 

  • Take AI research and experimentation through to production-ready solutions, collaborating with engineering and product teams to integrate models into Makersite's platform. 

  • Evaluate model performance and drive iterative improvements in accuracy, scalability, and practical application. 

Advance Makersite's AI Strategy 

  • Contribute to the evolution of Makersite's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to improve existing models, processes, and capabilities. 

  • Research emerging AI approaches and propose improvements to our AI stack and model development practices. 

Collaborate & Provide Technical Leadership 

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions. 

  • Share research findings and provide technical guidance, taking ownership of complex problems from exploration through to delivery. 


  • 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI research, or a related field. 

  • Research-oriented background in AI/ML, with demonstrable research contributions such as publications or technical papers.

jobs.description:
Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean based in Switzerland.

As an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts, you will bridge the worlds of architecture, customer relationship management, and software development. You will showcase innovative building configurators to international customers, demonstrating how complex project requirements can be transformed into permit-ready building designs within minutes. Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, and software developers, you will help improve product quality and ensure successful customer adoption. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence the future of digital building planning within an international, collaborative team.


Accountabilities:

You will combine product demonstrations, architectural quality assurance, and strategic account management to ensure that customers successfully adopt building configurators while providing valuable insights to improve the product.

  • Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean.

  • Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs.

  • Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules.

  • Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements.

  • Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

  • Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes.

  • Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate teams.

  • Workflow Analysis: Understand customer processes from initial site assessment through permitting, identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, or connect existing workflows.

  • Technical Requirements Translation: Convert customer workflows and operational needs into concrete software requirements, rules, and parameters for development teams.

  • Implementation & Customer Success: Coordinate product rollouts, support customers through implementation and productive use, and maintain engagement after launch.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines formal architectural training with strong communication, analytical, and customer-facing skills. You should understand how buildings are designed and planned, be comfortable discussing technical concepts with software engineers, and have the ability to translate complex customer workflows into practical software requirements.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture.

  • Practical experience in architectural design, building planning, or permitting processes is highly desirable.

  • Fluency in English and German is required, with Korean language proficiency considered a strong advantage.

  • Confidence presenting products and communicating with international customers in multiple languages.

  • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence, algorithms, and programming concepts.

  • Ability to understand rule-based systems, interpret simple scripts or logical structures, and communicate effectively with technical development teams.

  • Familiarity with BIM software such as Revit or Archicad is advantageous.

  • Experience with parametric design tools such as Grasshopper is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of architectural planning workflows and customer decision-making processes.

  • Ability to analyze operational processes, identify inefficiencies, and translate findings into clear software requirements.

  • Previous experience in key account management, consulting, or customer-facing project management is highly valued.

  • A forward-deployed mindset, with the ability to work directly with customers, take ownership of their success, and act as a bridge between customer teams and engineers.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a structured approach to testing and documentation.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer visits and on-site collaboration.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere worldwide.

  • Permanent employment contract.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of architecture, technology, and software innovation.

  • Direct interaction with international customers, including major retailers and real estate developers.

  • Opportunity to influence product development through direct customer feedback and architectural expertise.

  • Close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of architects, engineers, and software developers.

  • Short decision-making processes within a small, international team.

  • Opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions that transform building design and planning.

  • Flexible start date, with the possibility to join as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | Italy
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | Italy

At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in Italy only, preferably for candidates located in Milan and used to travel in the territory #LI-Remote

What you can expect to do this role:

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory (Italy, Greece, Cyprus, Malta)
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Italian is required and Spanish is preferred.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in EU territory around 50%.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

OTE represents the total target annual compensation, consisting of a fixed base salary and performance-based sales commissions. Variable compensation is dependent on the achievement of sales targets and is not guaranteed.

Employment terms, including job classification and applicable minimum salary provisions, are governed by the Italian National Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria)

Pay Transparency Range

€90.000—€124.700 EUR

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. jobs.description:
Account Executive - Enterprise

This is an opportunity for an experienced enterprise seller to join an Enterprise Sales Team that's already winning record-breaking deals, with a huge addressable market still to capture.

Vesper is seven years old, with strong product-market fit and a team of hard-working, ambitious people taking it to the next level! In this role and territory, you'll come up against just one competitor: one we're currently outpacing on technical development and new business.

This is not your typical AE role. You'll be joining a high-performing commercial organization with real ownership, real impact, and uncapped potential to hit your goals. It's a role for an ambitious closer looking for a high-growth company that's redefining the global food industry.

Why you should join us

  • Own Your Success: You have complete control over the sales cycle. No silos, no hand-holding; just real responsibility and the opportunity to make a massive impact.

  • Work With Customers Around the World: Start your morning with prospects in Asia, connect with European decision-makers by midday, and close deals in the Americas in the afternoon. You'll gain exposure to international markets and sharpen your skills across cultures.

What you get

  • A fun, young, and innovative atmosphere

  • An entrepreneurial environment where you learn something new every day

  • Personal responsibility with plenty of autonomy and room to grow

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment.

What you'll do

    Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

  • Growth Mindset:

What you'll need for this entry-level role:

  • Strong Attention to Detail

  • Basic Administrative Skills

Highly desirable

You'll be working on some of SumUp's biggest merchant-facing online products as part of the Bifrost team, contributing to growing and scaling critical products like Payment Links and Gift Cards, while also working on integration products that provide essential features used across many other SumUp products. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines.

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry

  • Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API

  • Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams

Your profile

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas).

  • Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).

  • Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD).

  • Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

  • Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API.

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style.

  • Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

jobs.title: Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)

Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command.

Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Provision Software and Firmware

  • Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed.

  • Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration.

  • Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures.

Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System

  • Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet).

  • Find faults systematically across hardware, wiring, network, and software, using multimeter, oscilloscope, and bus tools.

  • Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles.

Pull Logs and Find Root Causes

  • Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause.

  • If you cannot fix it yourself, hand engineering a precise, reproducible report; then confirm the fix on the vehicle.

Automate with AI

  • Use agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build scripts and tools for flashing, health checks, and log analysis.

  • Be creative: find pragmatic solutions where no procedure exists yet, and share what works with the team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree (electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer science, vehicle technology, or similar) or state certified Techniker / Meister with relevant practical experience. We hire for skills and drive, not titles.

  • First professional experience in vehicle electronics, E/E integration, ECU bring up, or prototype support in automotive, robotics, or autonomous driving. Strong graduates and young technicians with good projects are welcome.

  • Confident with Linux and the shell: SSH, services, logs, networking, file systems, installing packages. Scripting in Bash or Python.

  • Working knowledge of vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, Ethernet) and tools such as Vector CANoe / CANalyzer or open source equivalents.

  • Comfortable with measurement equipment and reading schematics and wiring diagrams.

  • You already use AI coding assistants or agentic workflows and want to push them further.

  • Creative, structured problem solver who documents what they do.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus. Driving license B.

Nice to have

  • ROS / ROS 2, Docker, Git.

  • HV qualification (e.g. DGUV 209-093).

  • Experience with autonomous vehicle sensors (lidar, radar, camera) and their calibration.

  • Own projects: microcontrollers, RC or model building, 3D printing, vehicle builds.

  • Defense or off road vehicle experience.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

Head of Revenue & Commercial Operations
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As our Head of Revenue & Commercial Operations, you will build the commercial operating engine that enables ANYbotics to scale.

Working directly with our CRO and closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance and Operations, you will create the processes, insights and operating rhythms that help us make better commercial decisions and execute consistently across regions.

This is a broad and highly hands-on role. You will own areas including forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, CRM governance, commercial reporting and sales effectiveness, while helping translate our go-to-market strategy into practical execution.

You will join at an important point in our growth. Our commercial organisation is becoming larger, more international and more sophisticated, and we need to build the infrastructure around it accordingly. You will have the opportunity to shape that model rather than inherit a finished function, establishing strong foundations and building the Revenue & Commercial Operations capability around you over time.

This is not a pure strategy role. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying what needs to improve, designing a practical solution and then getting close enough to the detail to make it happen.

Our customers are some of the world’s largest asset operators and industrial companies. ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection. Our technology enables customers to automate routine inspection work in environments that are complex, hazardous or difficult for people to access.

We are scaling quickly as industrial customers move from initial deployments towards broader adoption of autonomous inspection across their operations.

jobs.description:
Partner Solutions Engineer

About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships to help partners build, integrate, and deploy computer vision solutions with Ultralytics YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, scope partner projects, and turn requirements into practical solution architectures, demos, and deployments.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role with no people-management responsibilities. You'll collaborate with partners and internal engineering teams across model training, export, quantization, and cross-platform deployment. You'll thrive here if you combine deep technical curiosity with clear communication, sound judgment, and a bias for getting working solutions into users' hands.

🚀 What you'll do
Partner solutions & delivery

  • Lead partner-facing technical calls, discovery, and project scoping.

  • Design solution architectures for YOLO training, integration, export, and deployment.

  • Build technical demos and rapid prototypes using Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Support model export and INT8 quantization across ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, and LiteRT.

  • Help partners deploy across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and document clear implementation guidance.


Technical collaboration

  • Work side by side with the Head of Partnerships to advance partner integrations and unblock technical work.

  • Review partner and community GitHub pull requests and share actionable feedback.

  • Use OpenAI and Anthropic APIs to prototype client tools and accelerate partner workflows.

  • Share partner needs and technical findings with Product and Engineering teams.


Partner enablement

  • Create technical documentation, demos, and integration guidance using the Ultralytics docs and guides.

  • Represent Ultralytics in partner meetings, technical events, and occasional travel.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Experience in computer vision and AI, with practical knowledge of Python, YOLO, OpenCV, and PyTorch.

  • Experience training, exporting, and deploying models; familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, LiteRT, and INT8 quantization.

  • Proven ability to lead partner-facing technical calls, scope work, and deliver demos or solution architectures.

  • Experience reviewing GitHub pull requests and writing clear technical documentation.

  • Comfortable working across Linux, macOS, and Windows, with Docker and common development workflows.

  • Strong spoken and written English; able to travel for partner meetings and events.

  • Resourceful, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a high-performance startup.


Nice to have

  • Deep knowledge of vendor SDKs such as CUDA, ROCm, Vela, or Vitis AI.

  • Experience with edge CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, including Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Snapdragon, or Arm platforms.

  • Linux, Docker, and CI experience on ARM64 and x86; mobile or web deployment on Android, iOS, or WebGPU.

  • C++ skills, performance profiling, or experience with PyTorch and OpenCV optimization.

  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, and video pipelines like DeepStream or Triton.

  • Experience creating talks, blogs, or demo videos; additional Spanish, Italian, or Mandarin language skills.


🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine technical depth with a client-first, hands-on approach.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.


Our culture is built around our core values:

  • Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement.

  • Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail.

  • Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results.

  • Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities.

  • Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration.


Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive salary: Reflecting your experience and contribution.

  • Equity packages: We want our success to be yours too.

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs.

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI.


👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.

🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

  • This role is on-site at one of our global hubs: London or Madrid.

We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.

We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI. If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.

Manager, Enterprise Application Engineering, EMEA

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 

Role Overview

We're hiring a hands-on engineering manager for Harvey's Revenue Technology team. You'll bring software-engineering discipline to the systems our go-to-market organisation runs on, with Salesforce at the core and the CPQ, contracting, billing, marketing automation, revenue intelligence and post-sale platforms around it, and you'll put AI to work across that stack. You'll start as a player-coach: shipping yourself, setting the architecture and release practices for the system administrators and product owners already on the team, and hiring the engineers who come next. You'll be based in Dublin or London, with enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider team.

Harvey's go-to-market organisation is growing quickly, and this role owns the engineering practice behind its systems: how we design, build, test, release and monitor on Salesforce and the platforms around it, and the engineering standards across custom development, integrations and agents. The ideal candidate is a working manager: someone with hands-on Salesforce engineering and DevOps experience, who has led an engineering team and shipped AI agents that sellers actually use. Harvey builds AI for legal professionals; the internal bar has to match the external one.

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do

  • Stay hands-on. Spend a meaningful share of your time in the work - designing systems, reviewing code, writing integrations, unblocking your engineers on production issues. You set the technical bar by demonstrating it.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM platform. Take responsibility for how Salesforce and the surrounding GTM systems fit together across lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle, including reliability, data integrity, security posture, and lifecycle. Decide where customisation belongs and where it doesn't.

  • Drive AI enablement into the business. Apply AI and automation to how our go-to-market teams work, with the evaluation and guardrail practices that make it safe, and drive adoption with the teams that use it.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, onboard, and develop the software engineers who join Revenue Technology, and set the architectural direction for the system administrators and product owners you work alongside. Own the interview loop, ramp plans, and performance for the engineering discipline.

  • Partner with business and systems owners. Work directly with Sales, Marketing Operations, Customer Success and Support, Deal Desk, Finance Systems and Enterprise Integrations to turn ambiguous business problems into scoped, sequenced engineering work, and to say no clearly when something shouldn't be built.

  • Establish engineering standards. Define how this team writes, tests, deploys, documents, and monitors what it builds. Introduce the practices that scale a growing team without adding process for its own sake.

  • Anchor Revenue Technology in EMEA. Provide senior technical presence in Dublin or London for a growing international sales organisation, and hold enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider org.

  • Make build-vs-buy calls. Assess when a business need is better solved by configuration, a vendor, an integration, custom code or an agent we build, and make that call with cost, security, and long-term maintenance in view.

 

What You Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on engineering on Salesforce-centred business systems, and experience leading engineers as a manager, tech lead or architect.

  • Salesforce engineering experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, integrations) and hands-on experience setting up Salesforce DevOps: source control, CI/CD, sandbox strategy and release management.

  • Hands-on engineering depth in a modern language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar) and real experience designing and operating API-based integrations between business systems.

  • Working knowledge of the GTM stack beyond the CRM (CPQ, marketing automation, revenue intelligence, support and customer-success platforms, contract and billing systems) and how lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle actually flow across them.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping LLM-based agents or automations into production, outside a vendor's packaged agent product, with a clear point of view on evaluation, guardrails, and where the technology does and doesn't hold up.

  • Track record of hiring and developing engineers, and of raising the technical bar on a team you inherited or built.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and global environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience standing up an engineering practice inside a team that was previously admin- and configuration-led, or in a new office or region.

  • Background at a high-growth B2B SaaS company scaling through 2,000+ employees.

  • Hands-on work with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, or LLM gateway and evaluation tooling.

  • Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily working practice.

  • Experience with enterprise iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato) and event-driven integration patterns.

  • Exposure to legal, professional services, or another regulated industry.

Mandatory SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Expertise – Please Read Before Applying

For a large SAP S/4HANA transformation program at a major European infrastructure and transportation company, we are looking for five experienced Senior SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Developers to support the maintenance workstream.

The focus is on the hands-on development and enhancement of customer-specific SAP Fiori applications supporting maintenance, asset management and planning processes.

Three mandatory requirements:

  1. SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 Development: Several years of hands-on experience personally developing and enhancing SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications in customer projects.

  2. Frontend Development: Strong practical experience with SAPUI5, JavaScript, XML views, controllers and OData integration.

  3. Independent Delivery: Ability to independently analyze requirements, design, develop, test and troubleshoot SAP Fiori applications within a complex SAP project environment.

Previous experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Customer Service (CS), Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO), SAP Multi-Resource Scheduling (MRS) or production and maintenance planning is highly valued.

This is a hands-on SAP Fiori development assignment, not a purely ABAP backend development, functional SAP consulting or Fiori administration role.

Individual freelancers are welcome. Developers who have successfully worked together in previous SAP projects are also encouraged to apply.

  • Start: ASAP

  • Duration: 12 months+

  • Capacity: Full-time preferred, approx. 40 hours per week

  • Location: 100% remote, Europe preferred

  • Language: English

  • Level: Senior

  • Contract Type: Freelance / B2B

  • Number of Positions: 5

Your Responsibilities

You will design, develop, and maintain custom SAP Fiori applications and SAPUI5 user interfaces with a focus on Plant Maintenance modules. Your daily work involves collaborating with stakeholders to translate business requirements into efficient, user-friendly solutions within the SAP ecosystem.

Tasks

  • Independently design, develop, enhance and maintain customer-specific SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications within a large SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

  • Develop frontend solutions supporting maintenance, asset management and planning-related business processes.

  • Develop and enhance SAP Fiori Elements and Freestyle SAPUI5 applications.

  • Implement and integrate frontend applications using JavaScript, XML views, controllers, data binding and OData services.

  • Work closely with SAP backend developers, functional consultants, business process experts and the Technical Lead.

  • Support the integration of SAP Fiori applications with SAP S/4HANA backend functionality and relevant SAP business processes.

  • Support integration testing, user acceptance testing and application stabilization.

  • Proactively communicate development progress, technical dependencies, risks and potential improvements.

  • Contribute to common development standards, reusable components and knowledge sharing within the development team.

Requirements

  • Several years of professional hands-on SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development experience in complex SAP customer projects.

  • Proven experience personally developing customer-specific SAPUI5 applications beyond standard Fiori activation and configuration.

  • Strong practical knowledge of JavaScript, XML views, SAPUI5 controllers, data binding and application lifecycle management.

  • Experience with SAP Fiori Elements and/or Freestyle SAPUI5 development.

  • Strong understanding of OData services and frontend-to-backend integration.

  • Experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments.

  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience with frontend testing, technical documentation and structured software development processes.

  • Ability to independently deliver development tasks and proactively clarify incomplete or ambiguous requirements.

  • Experience working within international and distributed SAP development teams.

  • Professional English communication skills.

  • Availability for a long-term freelance / B2B assignment.

Nice-to-haves
