Senior AI Solution Specialist

Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor.

3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection.

  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function.

  • Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter.

  • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience

  • First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team.

  • Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines.

  • Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board.

12-Month Success Metrics:

  1. Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures.

  2. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion.

  3. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions.

  4. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows.

  5. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company.

Candidate Profile:

  • Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership.

  • Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert.

  • Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks.

  • AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks.

  • Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks.

  • FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains.

Bonus:

  • Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP).

  • Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures.

  • German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage.

Berlin.

jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative (Graduate/Junior) - 4 Day Week + Remote

No sales experience? Good. That's not what we're hiring for.

Most people you'll call didn't ask to hear from you. They're running construction sites, chasing programmes and fighting fires, and they'll give you about ten seconds to prove you're worth two minutes. Earn those two minutes, find a real problem, and you'll be opening doors at some of the UK's biggest construction firms. 

You don't need a sales CV for this. You need to be curious, resilient and genuinely coachable. We'll teach you the rest, with a proper 90-day plan, a coach alongside you every week, and a playbook built from the calls that are actually winning. 

It won't always be easy, but you'll learn faster than almost anywhere else. If you'd rather be genuinely good at sales in two years than comfortable in two months, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) 

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction! 

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION 

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. 

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it). 

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. 

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech 

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. 

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 

4 core values for a good life 

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: 

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world 

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. 

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: 

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

You're where every Shape deal starts: finding the right people at construction firms and booking qualified meetings that turn into free launches and contracts. It's a role for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up, in a team that cares about doing it well.

 

What the job actually is

Most of your day, every day, is on the phone. You'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. You'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" a lot. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself. 

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we're looking for people who feel the same. On the phone, that starts with a real conversation, not a script. It means being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and caring more about understanding someone's world than getting a calendar invite out of them. By the end of the call, you should know what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. Then you only offer a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, that's fine: you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having. 

 

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell. 

 

Where you'll work 

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future. 

 

Why it's worth it 

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. 

 

Your top responsibilities 

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.

 

Your roadmap: your first year 

Your first 90 days combine structured onboarding with a reduced target, so you learn properly before you're measured at full pace. 

  • Before day 1, ready to go: every tool set up and working, so week 1 is spent learning, not setting up.
  • Month 1, learn the why: how construction projects run and where they lose money, what Shape does about it, and the language of the industry. Listen to every call in our library, write your first-call pitch, role-play daily, and make your first supervised calls when you're ready.
  • Month 2, practise live: on the phones every day, with call reviews alongside you. We judge you on the quality of your conversations, not volume, as you book your first meetings.
  • Month 3, build consistency: building up to a full day of calling and booking regularly. Across your first three months, you work to half the full target.
  • From month 4, full target: the same target every SDR carries.
  • Months 4–6, make it consistent: the rest of your probation is about hitting that target month after month, with your own scorecard and weekly 1:1s.
  • Around 12 months, what's next: a progression conversation about Senior SDR or Account Executive, based on what you've shown, not how long you've been here. 

 

Why three months is realistic: it's fast compared with most sales teams, and that's deliberate. You won't be learning just from trial and error. You'll have a structured onboarding, a playbook built from calls that have won, daily call reviews early on, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. You will make mistakes, and that's fine. You won't be thrown in at the deep end. 

 

How you'll be measured 

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having?

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week.

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics.

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there. 

 

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next. 

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way. 

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

 

Your Capabilities 

Why experience isn't everything 

Sales skills can be taught. Attitude is much harder to teach, and bad habits are harder to unlearn than good ones are to learn. We'd rather hire someone hungry who gets better on every call than someone with three years of bad habits. So whether you're just finishing your studies or already have a year or two in sales or a customer-facing role, this is the role for you. If you have 2+ years of outbound B2B behind you, take a look at our Senior SDR role instead.

What we look for instead 

  • A forever learner: you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it.
  • A sponge, with no ego: you soak everything up, take feedback and actually change what you do on the next call, and never think you're above the basics.
  • Resilient and disciplined: you can hear "no" twenty times before lunch and still mean it on call twenty-one. You've stuck at something hard and kept showing up when it got tough, whether that's competitive sport, music, a part-time job alongside your studies, volunteering or a society you helped run.
  • Curious, and a genuine listener: you ask the second question and listen to understand, not to wait for your turn. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • Quick on your feet: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and speak plainly and confidently. You don't need to be loud, just credible.
  • A strategist who takes action: you think about who to call, when and why, then get on with it without waiting to be told. You listen to calls and practise before anyone asks you to.
  • You've done your homework: you understand, at a high level, the problems people in construction face, and you can clearly say why construction and why this job. "My dad's an electrician" is a start, not an answer. 

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining) 

  • Any sales or customer-facing experience, such as retail, hospitality or recruitment, especially where you had targets to hit.
  • A competitive streak, mostly with yourself.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-growing business.
  • Experience using a CRM, a dialler or other sales tools.
  • Any construction site experience, through work, a placement or an apprenticeship. 
 
Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: 
  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

 

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. 
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. 
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions. We care much more about your answers than your CV. 
  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's something you've stuck at, even when it got hard, and what did it teach you? 

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate. 

What happens next 

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages: 

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

jobs.title: Director, Venture Cafe London
jobs.description:
Director, Venture Cafe London

Are you a natural leader with a strong network, driven to tackle your city's biggest challenges and connect diverse groups to make things happen? If so, you belong at Venture Café!

At Venture Café, we aim to create a global community of innovators with equal access to resources and opportunities, addressing our most pressing challenges. Ready to make an impact with us?

 

The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. This is a unique opportunity to operate and grow a hub for Deeptech innovation and connection, in close collaboration with ARIA.

 

ABOUT VENTURE CAFÉ

Venture Café believes that Isolation is the enemy of innovation and our mission is clear: Connect innovators to make things happen. We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone. 

Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. Featuring vibrant networking sessions activated with captivating demos or immersion in the night’s theme by attending thought-provoking sessions led by inspiring speakers. Here, curiosity meets opportunity, connections flourish, and innovation thrives.

Venture Café was founded by Tim Rowe, founder and CEO of the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC), in 2009 and helped fuel the growth of one of the world’s most powerful innovation ecosystems: Boston’s Kendall Square. What began with a modest gathering of 12 people at our inaugural Thursday Gathering has flourished into the Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI). Over the past 15 years, VCGI has united over 900,000 visionaries, developers, creatives, and civic leaders across 24cities worldwide, building a global community of communities.

At VCGI, we believe if we’re going to solve humankind’s biggest challenges, we need as many amazing humans as possible involved in that process.

 

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK

Reporting to the Head of UK, Venture Cafe United Kingdom, you will lead the established Venture Café London team, directing programming for the Thursday Gathering and other ecosystem-building activities. Your goal is to ensure Venture Café programming continues to connect local innovators to the national and international entrepreneurship community.

Your role would be to execute weekly Venture Café Thursday Gatherings including the following:

• Collaborating closely with VCGI and ARIA to continue to successfully implement and refine the strategy for Venture Café London.

• Scoping and securing financial partners for Venture Café London and building a pipeline for funding opportunities.

• Working closely with the Head of UK and the other UK Directors to ensure success and align initiatives where appropriate.

• Scoping and developing a rolling programming strategy to inspire and connect the local innovation community.

• Collaborate with the ARIA team and Programme Directors to drive value to the ARIA Opportunity Spaces.

• Identifying and partnering with local ecosystem leaders as an advocate and spokesperson to build diverse and inclusive programs.

• Developing innovative program formats for delivering content and creating connection opportunities to maximize engagement.

• Leading and overseeing strategic planning, impact measurement and program budget for Venture Café in London.

• Attracting sponsorship for programs and aligning them within the Thursday Gathering framework.

• Leading and coaching your three direct reports towards success.

• Continuously reviewing and implementing improvements/changes to ensure the ongoing success and reputation of Venture Café London.

• Collaborating with the Venture Café global network and ARIA to connect the London community to global opportunities.

• Identifying and mitigating risks to the effective operation of the Thursday Gathering.

• Nurturing existing initiatives to support Venture Café’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB) efforts, while bringing a visionary approach to developing and expanding DEIB-driven programming and partnership opportunities.

 

ABOUT YOU

You understand your city’s challenges and see them as opportunities, combining a fascination with trends and a humanistic perspective. Passionate about mission-driven work, you'll lead Venture Café London by nurturing relationships, leading teams, and thriving in ambiguity. Your skills include leading programs, matchmaking, innovating, connecting with the community, and fostering collaboration. You are comfortable with public speaking, have excellent communication skills, and excel at connecting across business, academia, government, and civil society. You bring a global outlook with local roots and a strong community commitment. 

​​More specifically, you thrive in:

• Leading people and complex programs.

• Being a match-maker extraordinaire and seeing opportunities at the intersections of people, ideas & resources.

• Envisioning, developing and implementing innovative program experiences.

• Connecting with a broad cross-section of the community. 

• Bringing people together to collaborate towards a common goal.

• Identifying and developing mutually beneficial partnerships.

Additionally, you have:

• Knowledge of London’s  startup community, key influencers, networks and organizations.

• Excellent organizational, project, and task management skills.

• Experience securing funding opportunities and a network of potential funders. 

• Comfort in Google Suite, email campaign software, and project management software.

• Fluency in English.

• Ability to legally work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.

 

OUR OFFER

• Employment contract.

• Competitive compensation based on experience

• 4% Pension Contribution
• 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays
• Supplemental medical and dental insurance
• £200 Monthly Commuter Allowance
• Life insurance
• Business Travel Insurance
• Hybrid work model – You will work three days per week in the office, with Thursdays required as a core in-office day.

VENTURE CAFÉ LONDON - GUIDING ORGANIZATIONAL OBJECTIVES

As an organization, Venture Café London is guided by five core objectives that shape how success is measured. These objectives are advanced through purposeful programming, storytelling, and bringing together a diverse community of innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, corporates, and ecosystem partners.

  1. Broaden access to innovation and economic opportunity. Lower barriers to entry and create an inclusive, welcoming environment where people from diverse backgrounds can participate in and contribute to London's innovation ecosystem.

  2. Connect people and break down silos. Build bridges across sectors, disciplines, industries, and communities to encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the development of a globally competitive innovation ecosystem.

  3. Improve access to resources and opportunities. Foster meaningful relationships that connect innovators and entrepreneurs with the capital, talent, expertise, ideas, and strategic partnerships they need to develop and scale their ventures.

  4. Create spaces for meaningful human connection. Bring people together through accessible, engaging experiences that encourage the exchange of ideas, build trust, and turn spontaneous interactions into lasting relationships and collaborations.

  5. Strengthen the wider innovation ecosystem through shared resources. Openly share knowledge, tools, and opportunities while collaborating with ecosystem partners to align efforts, amplify impact, and support collective progress.

The Venture Café Gathering

The flagship Venture Café model is the weekly Gathering: a recurring community event where innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, and other ecosystem stakeholders come together to exchange ideas, share knowledge, explore emerging technologies, and build meaningful connections.

Through expert-led discussions, educational sessions, networking opportunities, and informal interactions, the Gathering creates the conditions for collaboration and new opportunities to emerge organically. It serves as a platform for connecting London's innovation community and provides a foundation for wider programming, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem-building initiatives.

The Gathering is more than an event; it is a recurring platform for strengthening relationships across the innovation ecosystem and helping promising ideas develop into meaningful collaborations and real-world outcomes.

 

 

Venture Café welcomes all candidates regardless of race, color, ancestry, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status or disability. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Senior Data Scientist

We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

About the role

To deliver on this mission, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Tech Flex team.

The Tech Flex team was established in early 2026, and has been growing strongly since then. The team is focused on greenfield opportunities at the cutting edge of Octopus' flexibility strategy, and aims to enable rapid response to opportunities, globally and across a wide range of domains. 

Time series forecasting is a critical capability across essentially all of our workstreams. Through this role, we aim to build a new capability within an already data-literate team. The intent is that this role will:

  • Act as an owner of time series forecasting expertise, and so will work across any project that has a forecasting component

  • Will not be explicitly limited to time series forecasting. Our team’s growth will continue to be dynamic, and so we expect this role to engage with backend engineering, data engineering, MLOps, machine learning, essentially to act as a ‘full stack data scientist’ with a specialisation on time series forecasting

We are building the next generation of products and tools to make energy more flexible. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. The team develops products that are used by millions of customers, helping boost renewables use and decarbonise energy systems worldwide.

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.


What you'll do

  • Acting as the Tech Flex’s first full-time data scientist, establish the team’s DS capability, lead the team’s DS technical direction and represent the team to the cross-team DS community

  • Approach projects with a ‘product-oriented’ mindset, to discover requirements and technical challenges that can only be seen with a DS lens, then to communicate risks, tradeoffs and opportunities to team leads 

  • Establish greenfield forecasting systems upon the foundational layer of data engineering and warehousing that has been established in our own AWS environment(s)

  • Work closely with the centralised market forecasting team, extending their system to meet the needs of our platform

  • Interface with the established data warehouse, built on Databricks

  • Upskill data-literate backend engineers, act as the team's forecasting expert, and as a multiplier on other engineers' impact


    • What you'll have

  • Strong aptitude with Python and AWS data stack

  • Experience building real-world time series forecasting systems, ideally in the energy sector

  • Experience with Databricks, Airflow, DBT

  • A passion for data visualisation and visual communication

  • The ability to communicate the subtleties of data science concept to non-DS engineers and managers

  • Familiarity with Bayesian reasoning

  • Experience with MLOps engineering, the full model lifecycle

  • If you are new to energy, you should be able to demonstrate the ability to quickly understand new domain areas

  • Team player excited at the idea of ownership across lots of different projects and tools

  • Passion for driving towards Net Zero

  • Able to travel to Octopus office in London semi-regularly

  • Desirable: energy domain knowledge/experience

  • Beneficial: Experience in Kubernetes, Docker, Spark 

  • Beneficial: data science-focused observability & monitoring experience (e.g. DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus)

  • Databricks Spark for data processing

  • Databricks/dbt/SQL for data modelling and analytics

  • Streamlit for data applications and visualisations

  • Airflow for job scheduling and tracking

  • CircleCI for CI/CD

  • Parquet and Delta file formats on S3 for data lake storage

  • Terraform for our infrastructure definition

  • Kubernetes for data services and task orchestration

  • Datadog/Grafana/Prometheus for platform monitoring

  • Django for custom databases and frameworks

The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

We were named the UK's top company to work for in 2025, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

Senior Backend Engineer (Power Networks)

We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

About the role

To deliver on this mission, we are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Tech Flex team.

The Tech Flex team was established in early 2026, and has been growing strongly since then. The team is focused on greenfield opportunities at the cutting edge of Octopus' flexibility strategy, and aims to enable rapid response to opportunities across a wide range of domains. 

Power networks are critical to the energy transition. Electrification and the increasing distribution of devices to the edges of the grid creates fundamental physics-based challenges that can only be solved by working closely with power networks, especially DSOs. Our team’s conviction is that we can utilise flexibility to solve the hardest challenges with our DSO partners.

We are building the next generation of products and tools to make energy more flexible. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. The team develops products that are used by millions of customers, helping boost renewables use and decarbonise energy systems worldwide.

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.


What you'll do

  • Acting as a senior backend engineer, you will take responsibility for large features and projects, fostering trust between yourself and team leads that you can own complexity, improve the team, and deliver on commitments

  • Utilise your experience working with power networks/power flow /modelling/power systems/electrical engineering to deliver value to DSO partners, data centers, and utilities

  • Approach projects with a ‘product-oriented’ mindset, to discover requirements and technical challenges, then to communicate risks, tradeoffs and opportunities to team leads

  • Establish greenfield technology that leverages the best of our core Multiflex platform, and spend time working on the core platform itself

  • Work closely with our OE Networks stakeholders to understand what is needed, and communicate what is possible

  • Experience working for or with DSOs/TSOs/integrated utilities, and a strong understanding of how they see the world

  • The ability to communicate power systems concepts to newcomers

  • Team player excited at the idea of ownership across lots of different projects and tools

  • Passion for driving towards Net Zero

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

This company is far more than a traditional real estate brokerage — it is a tech-powered media company reinventing how real estate is bought, sold, and experienced, combining elite sales talent, cutting-edge technology, and world-class content creation to build a completely new industry approach; its ecosystem spans luxury residential real estate, a powerful education platform, and an in-house creative agency, forming a vertically integrated model that is reshaping the real estate landscape, while offering engineers the opportunity to join an organization that treats technology as a core strategic differentiator, empowers small, autonomous, high-impact teams with full ownership, and values great design, clean code, and exceptional user experience, all within a company that is actively building the future of real estate.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact fintech-focused engineering team building resilient, scalable, and data-intensive systems. This role requires deep expertise across the full stack, from designing PostgreSQL schemas and distributed backend services to delivering polished React/Next.js user experiences. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who values reliability, operational excellence, and clean architecture, with experience handling complex financial workflows, asynchronous event processing, and high-stakes transactional data. You will work in a fast-paced environment with strong ownership, leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to deliver robust production-grade solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle of product features, from database schema design and backend implementation to frontend delivery and production monitoring.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable event-driven and distributed systems with strong guarantees around reliability and data consistency.

  • Develop and optimize complex PostgreSQL queries, migrations, and transactional workflows for high-performance financial operations.

  • Build resilient integrations with third-party systems using webhooks, queues, retry mechanisms, and reconciliation processes.

  • Implement reliability engineering patterns including idempotency, dead-letter queues (DLQs), outbox patterns, and fault-tolerant processing.

  • Create responsive and high-quality user interfaces using React and Next.js.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve system scalability, observability, and operational excellence.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar platforms to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery.

  • Participate in code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices for handling sensitive financial and transactional data.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders to deliver exceptional user experiences.

  • Implement and maintain observability and monitoring solutions using tools such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

  • Contribute to infrastructure automation and cloud resource management using Infrastructure as Code practices such as Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Ensure engineering practices align with security, compliance, and regulated-environment requirements including SOC2 and PCI-DSS standards where applicable.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Engineer delivering production-ready applications end-to-end.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Advanced experience with React and Next.js.

  • Deep expertise in PostgreSQL and database engineering, including raw SQL, query optimization, migrations, and performance analysis.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining event-driven and distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of reliability engineering patterns, including:

    • Idempotency keys and retry strategies

    • Dead-letter queues (DLQs)

    • Outbox patterns

    • Reconciliation processes for data consistency

  • Experience building webhook-driven architectures and integrating third-party systems.

  • Solid understanding of scalable system architecture, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant applications.

  • Experience working with financial, payments, billing, payroll, or ledgering systems.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding platforms.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a systems-thinking mindset and attention to edge cases and data integrity.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work autonomously within high-impact engineering teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-heavy environments, including SOC2 or PCI-DSS.

  • Knowledge of property-based testing frameworks such as fast-check for validating complex business logic.

  • Experience optimizing applications for scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

  • Prior experience mentoring engineers and participating in technical leadership initiatives.

  • Experience working within fintech or high-transaction-volume platforms.

  • Exposure to modern AI-enhanced engineering workflows and automation practices.

  • Experience collaborating within autonomous, product-focused engineering teams.

  • Passion for clean architecture, exceptional user experience, and high-quality software craftsmanship.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
  • Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

Data Sales Director, South Korea

Role highlights:

  • Data Sales Director

  • Location: Seoul, South Korea

  • Department: International Data Sales

  • Reports to: Head of International Data Sales

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Seoul, South Korea, with national and international travel

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening, as required for defence-related roles in South Korea

Why This Role Matters

As a Data Sales Director for South Korea, you'll be at the forefront of ICEYE's commercial growth: hunting, cultivating, and closing data sales opportunities across the Korean market. You'll build strategic relationships with defence, intelligence, and security customers in a country with deep roots in advanced technology and a growing focus on sovereign geospatial capability, driving adoption of the world's leading SAR satellite constellation.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Own territory planning and execute end-to-end sales campaigns across South Korea, from lead generation through to contract close

  • Initiate and develop executive-level relationships with defence, intelligence, and security customers across South Korea, directly and through the agency and vendor ecosystem

  • Lead contract negotiations and deliver customised proposals in coordination with marketing

  • Build and manage a healthy customer pipeline, accelerating adoption of ICEYE's satellite imagery data and products

  • Work with partners to extend reach and identify new opportunities across the assigned territory

  • Ensure long-term customer success and satisfaction within key strategic accounts

  • Engage with Korean defence procurement frameworks and government contracting processes (e.g. DAPA, Ministry of National Defense) to position ICEYE effectively in the region

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • Proven track record in a hunting sales role within the Korean market

  • Extensive existing customer network across South Korea, particularly in defence, intelligence, or security sectors

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex contract negotiations and close high-value deals

  • Self-motivated and able to manage a pipeline independently with a high degree of autonomy

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Korean and English

Nice to Haves

  • Background in geospatial, satellite imagery, or Earth Observation sales

  • Experience in Aerospace and Defence, consulting, or other relevant tech-focused industries

  • Familiarity with the agency and vendor ecosystem in the Korean and wider Asia-Pacific defence and intelligence market

  • Understanding of Korean sovereign defence programmes and procurement structures

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible, we set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious, go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the 'why' behind decisions.

  • See the big picture, stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork, create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team, we win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun, what we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us, we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building

Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Our offer to you

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

• Help define how we scale: processes, tools, talent, culture.

Requirements

• 5+ years in professional services (e. g. consulting, system integration, sales of complex products) or in a product-driven start-up or scale-up.

• Proven consultative selling capacity: you can win complex enterprise deals by advising, not pitching.

• Solid understanding of digital products: you like working with users and engineers alike and you can define requirements that engineers can make real.

• Thorough and pragmatic: you think problems through and deliver concrete results.

• Challenger mindset: you shape how clients and the market at large think about professional services sourcing and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders.

• AI-affinity: you actively use AI tools and understand the strategic implications of agentic AI for professional services.

• Entrepreneurial energy – you are drawn to building markets, not administering existing ones. Own entrepreneurial experience is a strong plus.

• Strong academic background, fast career progression, proven commercial impact.

• Fluent in German and English (DACH is our home market, while we expand internationally).

• Network power: you have and build valuable relationships easily.

Benefits

• Attractive compensation with fixed salary, variable component tied to the commercial success of your Vicos, and company shares (ESOP in place).

• Entrepreneurial key position in an industry-transforming company with direct impact on company results, the market, and your personal growth.

• High degree of autonomy in how you develop your client portfolio, work with Vico Leads and shape the product.

• Fast-paced environment with a highly talented team of diverse backgrounds and top-notch qualifications.

• Flexibility in how and where you work – remote and/or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Barcelona, Berlin, Seville).

Prendre la tête du pôle Search tout juste unifié (Paid, SEO et GEO) et en faire le premier moteur de croissance rentable de l'entreprise, avec un budget paid media annuel à 8 chiffres.

En 5 hashtags, ça donne 👉 #PaidSearch #SEA #SEO #GEO #tROAS

🍒 sur le 🎂 : tu arrives au moment où tout se construit. Les équipes Paid et SEO viennent d'être fusionnées pour sortir du silo par canal, le projet tROAS est relancé en priorité avec tout un chapitre à écrire, et la roadmap IA / LLM / GEO est à bâtir de zéro, avec des outils IA internes déjà interfacés avec l'écosystème technique.

🚀 Tes missions principales :

  • Définir et porter une vision Search unifiée (SEA, SEO et GEO) et la roadmap qui va avec, pour maximiser la valeur globale plutôt que la performance de chaque canal pris isolément.

  • Piloter le Paid Search au quotidien avec une vraie responsabilité business : revenu, ROAS, CAC, rentabilité, avec un suivi rigoureux des parts de visibilité face à la concurrence.

  • Mener le projet tROAS : fiabilisation du tracking, objectifs de ROAS par produit et par segment, enchères basées sur la valeur, test & learn structuré.

  • Arbitrer les investissements selon leur valeur incrémentale, et piloter la cannibalisation entre paid, SEO, direct et marque.

  • Accélérer le plan de reconquête SEO engagé, pour retrouver le leadership organique sur le marché.

  • Construire la visibilité de la marque dans les moteurs IA (Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) et la mesure qui va avec : présence, citations, part de voix.

  • Faire de l'IA et de l'automatisation un réflexe dans l'équipe, pour en finir avec les tâches faites à la main.

  • Rassurer et embarquer : reporting régulier auprès de la direction générale et du groupe, en anglais.

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences ton équipe de 4 personnes en direct et 3 en indirect.

💛 Ton équipe :

  • L'entreprise : un comparateur digital dans les secteurs de l’assurance et des services financiers, créé il y a 14 ans et réunissant une centaine de personnes à son siège parisien. En forte croissance, sa culture est tech, rapide et collaborative.

  • Ton équipe : 7 personnes de qualité, volontaires et agréables au quotidien. Côté SEO, tu manages en direct 3 chef·fes de projet répartis par typologie de produits, dont un profil senior référent IA de l'équipe. Côté Paid, tu manages le Head of Paid Acquisition, qui encadre 2 traffic managers et une responsable acquisition médias digitaux et partenariats.

  • Ton manager : le CMO : très humain et motivant pour ses équipes, c’est un véritable manager-mentor : il accompagne la progression de chacun·e et donne les moyens de réussir.

  • Tes interlocuteurs : tu évolues au sein d’une équipe marketing d’une trentaine de personnes, avec des expertises clés en CRM, branding, contenus et service client. Tu collabores également avec les équipes data, produit et tech, ainsi qu’avec tes homologues à l’international.

💻 Tes Conditions de travail :

  • Ton bureau : de très beaux bureaux, hyper agréables, dans le 17ème arrondissement de Paris, à côté du Parc Monceau.

  • Le midi : pas de cantine, mais une carte tickets restaurant.

  • Ton package de rémunération :

    • Salaire fixe : entre 80 et 95k€ brut annuels, selon expérience.

    • Salaire variable : jusqu’à 5% de ton salaire fixe par an

    • Participation/Intéressement : Participation jusqu'à 10% du salaire annuel selon les objectifs d'entreprise (rentabilité, marge), soit jusqu’à 9k€/an + Intéressement.

    • Autres avantages : très bonne mutuelle, prime annuelle de vacances (environ 800€ cette année), primes culture et sport, soirées au minimum une fois par mois.

  • Ton rythme :

    • 5 semaines de congés payés

    • Une dizaine de jours de RTT par an.

    • Jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine (et encore plus de souplesse sur juillet/août).

    • Possibilité de semaine en full-remote durant les fêtes de fin d’année.


Tes expériences & compétences :

  • Tu as l'habitude des organisations où le reporting est soutenu, y compris auprès d'une direction générale ou d'un groupe.

  • Tu as une solide culture SEO : sans forcément être un·e expert·e technique, tu sais définir une stratégie, challenger tes experts et piloter le levier.

  • Tu as une forte appétence pour l'IA et le GEO, et idéalement tu as déjà mené tes premières expérimentations concrètes.

  • Tu as plusieurs années de management derrière toi, idéalement de profils seniors ou de managers.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment, c'est indispensable pour travailler avec le groupe.

  • Un passage en agence serait un vrai plus, notamment pour l'accès aux bêta-tests et la culture de l'innovation.

  • Une expérience en comparateur, marketplace, assurance ou services financiers serait appréciée.

Ta personnalité :

  • Business avant tout, tu relies chaque choix Search à la croissance, au revenu incrémental et à la rentabilité.

  • Rigoureux·se et pointu·e, tu pilotes au quotidien, tu anticipes et tu sais que la performance se joue souvent dans le détail.

  • Leader et pédagogue, tu tires une équipe vers le haut, y compris des profils qui s'y connaissent déjà, en donnant un cap clair sans tomber dans le micromanagement.

  • Curieux·se et pragmatique, tu testes vite les nouveautés IA et tu ne gardes que ce qui crée de la valeur.

Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job :

C'est un poste pour quelqu'un qui veut bâtir un pôle et pas juste reprendre un périmètre. Le Search est le plus gros levier de croissance de la boîte, les moyens sont là (budget paid >10M€/an) et la fusion SEA/SEO/GEO est encore à orchestrer. Si tu es un·e pro du paid qui rêve d'avoir enfin la main sur toute la chaîne Search, avec l'IA en terrain de jeu, tu es au bon endroit !
