Accounting Manager

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in Switzerland.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. You will manage the General Ledger (GL) team while taking ownership of accounting processes for newly acquired entities, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration. Working closely with senior finance leadership, M&A specialists, external auditors, tax advisors, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate financial reporting and effective multi-GAAP consolidation. You will play a central role in strengthening accounting structures, improving financial controls, and supporting the group's continued international expansion. This position offers the opportunity to develop expertise in M&A accounting, statutory reporting, and multi-entity financial management. You will also drive innovation by introducing AI-powered tools and automation to make finance operations more efficient and scalable.


Accountabilities

  • M&A Due Diligence and Integration: Lead the accounting workstream for potential acquisitions, conducting financial due diligence and managing post-merger integration activities, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation support, and fair-value adjustments.

  • NetSuite Implementation and Onboarding: Manage the integration of newly acquired businesses into NetSuite, designing and configuring their chart of accounts, reporting dimensions, and accounting structures to ensure seamless financial onboarding.

  • Financial Consolidation and Multi-GAAP Reporting: Oversee consolidation for newly acquired entities and manage multi-book reporting across different accounting standards, ensuring alignment between group reporting and local statutory GAAP requirements. Handle intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and reporting adjustments.

  • General Ledger and Month-End Close: Lead the GL function and ensure accurate, timely, and consistent month-end closing processes across multiple international entities.

  • Entity Accounting and Tax Compliance: Oversee accounting and statutory reporting for European, Canadian, and US entities, coordinating with external tax advisors to ensure compliance with local tax regulations and reporting obligations.

  • Statutory Audit Management: Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating and managing statutory audits, particularly across European and Canadian entities.

  • Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Process Optimization and Automation: Review existing accounting and consolidation workflows, implement scalable financial controls, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and practical applications of AI tools.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the CFO, Director of Accounting and Tax, M&A and Controlling teams, external advisors, and portfolio company leadership to support financial integration and strategic decision-making.

Cybersecurity Engineer

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

This role will be focused on understanding and reducing the security risk of Fever's cloud infrastructure and data. You will run technical risk assessments of our AWS environments, data platforms and new architectures, identify the weaknesses that could lead to a security incident or a data breach, and work with the owning teams until those risks are fixed.

As part of the Cybersecurity team, you will focus on defensive security in cloud and data environments: where our sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, how it is protected, and how secure the infrastructure underneath is. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact in a high-growth global category leader, working alongside experts to implement best practices and innovative security solutions. If you're passionate about cloud and data security and enjoy tackling challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you on board!

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, data platforms, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, risk methodology and overall security landscape.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will run infrastructure and architecture risk assessments using our risk methodology.
  • You will map where sensitive data is stored and processed (S3, databases, data warehouse, SaaS) and who can access it.
  • You will participate in security configuration reviews to ensure cloud and data environments meet industry standards.
  • You will develop automation to detect data exposure, excessive permissions and misconfigurations.
  • You will participate in vulnerability management sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous security improvements.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will own the risk assessment process for infrastructure and data, from design reviews to risk acceptance.
  • You will drive the remediation of the main data and infrastructure risks with clear owners and deadlines.
  • You will lead initiatives to implement secure solutions for data: classification, encryption and key management, and least-privilege access.
  • You will act as a point of contact for technical guidance on cloud architecture, data security and configurations.
  • You will develop cybersecurity technical documentation and secure best practices guidelines to educate and support stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform technical risk assessments and threat models of cloud infrastructure, data platforms and new architectures, and document residual risk.
  • Maintain the infrastructure and data risk register, prioritising risks and tracking treatment plans with owners.
  • Identify, classify and protect sensitive data across AWS services, data warehouses and SaaS (data security posture).
  • Review and enforce encryption, key management (KMS), network isolation and identity and access controls for data stores.
  • Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in the AWS ecosystem.
  • Develop and deploy automated security solutions to detect, report and remediate data exposure and misconfigurations.
  • Collaborate with Data, DevOps and engineering teams to build security into data pipelines and infrastructure.

About you

Must have:

  • Proven experience performing security risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and architectures (threat modeling, likelihood/impact, residual risk).
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure security including IAM, networking, KMS, S3, logging and organisation-level controls.
  • Good understanding of data security: data classification, encryption, access governance and data loss prevention.
  • Experience securing data platforms (e.g. data lakes, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks or similar) and their pipelines.
  • Proficiency in scripting for automation and security operations (Python, Go or similar).
  • Knowledge of risk and cloud security frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and explain risk to technical and business audiences.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud security and/or cybersecurity roles.
  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), CNAPP or CSPM tools.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations affecting data (GDPR) and PCI DSS.
  • Security certifications (e.g. CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, CRISC, CISSP or similar).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

Bid Manager

Bid Manager

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

Most of the contracts we win in UK healthcare start life as a tender, as do a growing number of deals with private providers, social care organisations and national programmes. We’re looking for a Bid Manager to own that process across the UK and Ireland, from deciding which opportunities to chase to pressing submit.

You’ll work with Commercial, Medical Operations, Clinical Safety, Product, Security and Finance, and turn what we know into answers an evaluator can score. Your job is to help us win more of the right bids, and to build the process and content library that makes every bid after that faster.

What You Will Do

  • Own bids end to end: qualification, bid/no-bid decisions, planning, kick-off, drafting, review, compliance checks, submission and clarification questions.

  • Bid across the whole market: NHS trusts, ICBs and primary care, national frameworks, local authority social care, central government and devolved nations’ programmes, and private and independent sector providers.

  • Write and edit responses on clinical value, implementation, clinical safety, information governance, security, social value and pricing.

  • Work with subject matter experts (clinicians, clinical safety officers, engineers, security and finance) to get the right input on time, and turn complex technical and regulatory detail into clear, compliant answers.

  • Develop win themes and executive summaries that connect our evidence to what each buyer is actually scoring.

  • Track upcoming tenders, frameworks and dynamic markets, and help Commercial leadership decide where to spend our effort.

  • Keep the bid library current: standard answers, case studies, evidence, policies and certifications.

  • Run post-bid reviews, collect evaluator feedback and use it to lift our win rate.

  • Work with the delivery team to track the social value commitments we make once a contract is awarded.

  • Improve how we bid, including the AI tools and workflows we already use to draft and review answers.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Bid Manager or senior Bid Writer, with a track record of winning public sector healthcare or social care contracts.

  • Working knowledge of UK public procurement, including the Procurement Act 2023, the Provider Selection Regime, frameworks and dynamic markets.

  • Experience beyond the NHS, such as local authorities, central government, devolved administrations, or private and independent sector buyers.

  • Excellent writing. You can make a complex answer short, clear and compliant, and we’ll ask you to show us.

  • Strong project management. You can run several bids at once, hold people to deadlines and stay calm the night before a noon submission.

  • Confidence working with senior clinical, technical and commercial stakeholders, and challenging them when an answer isn’t good enough yet.

  • Commercial judgement about which bids are worth pursuing, and the confidence to recommend a no-bid.

  • Comfort in a fast-paced scale-up and genuine enthusiasm for using AI in your own work.

Bonus Points

  • Experience bidding for digital health, health tech or SaaS contracts.

  • Familiarity with NHS digital standards such as DTAC, DSPT, DCB0129 and DCB0160.

  • Experience with frameworks such as NHS SBS, Crown Commercial Service or regional NHS frameworks.

  • APMP accreditation or equivalent.

  • Experience bidding in Ireland or other European markets.

  • A clinical, social care or public sector commissioning background.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with Hiring Manager

  3. Bid writing task - a written response to a sample tender question, followed by a discussion with the Hiring Manager

  4. Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • £800 wellness budget per year

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Data Analyst - Logistics

Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.

Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data.

What you get 

  • A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. 

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. 

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. 

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. 

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. 

  • Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. 

About us 

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. 

 
What the job looks like 

  • Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.

  • Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.

  • Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.

  • Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.

  • Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.


What you bring 

  • Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.

  • Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.

  • Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.

  • Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.

  • AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.

  • Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.

  • Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

 
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

jobs.title: Market Development Representative
jobs.description:
Market Development Representative

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Everything we build now runs through one question: how do we supercharge productivity with AI?

ClickUp Brain and our agentic AI capabilities are the center of gravity for the company. We're not bolting AI onto a project management tool, we're building the platform where AI does real work: drafting, summarizing, routing, researching, and executing alongside the humans who use it. That focus is external and internal. We expect our customers to get radically more productive with AI, and we expect the same of ourselves. Every ClickUp employee is given the tools, the training, and the mandate to use AI in their daily workflow.

This is an AI-native role. You will use AI every day to research faster, personalize at scale, prep calls, and keep your pipeline clean. You will also be selling AI, so you need to speak about it credibly.

The Role

As a Market Development Representative (MDR), you'll serve as the critical bridge between our marketing efforts and the sales team, playing a pivotal role in accelerating our revenue pipeline. You will be responsible for meticulously following up on, nurturing, and qualifying all inbound leads generated from our diverse marketing channels. This role is fundamental to ensuring our sales team engages only with the most promising and well-prepared prospects.

In this position, you'll act as the first point of contact and a trusted educator for potential customers. Your mission is to understand their initial interest, assess their business needs, and articulate the value of our platform, including how our AI capabilities change what their team is capable of. You will manage the crucial early stages of the buyer's journey, building rapport and filtering for high-potential opportunities before seamlessly transitioning them to an Account Executive.

This is a high-velocity motion: sub-30 day cycles, pipeline generation at scale, and relentless execution. MDRs don't win by out-strategizing over weeks. They win by out-hustling, out-qualifying, and out-persisting, turning every inbound signal into a qualified opportunity that sticks downstream.

How We Hire, Coach and Measure: The Four Pillars

Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value proposition in every qualification conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly (Zoom, phone, email) to all inbound leads generated by marketing activities: handraisers, account signals, content, webinars, social campaigns, and events.

  • Qualify marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) using a consistent framework to determine sales readiness and fit, and distinguish buyers from browsers.

  • Nurture leads through in-depth conversations, acting as an educator and advisor rather than focusing solely on immediate conversions.

  • Uncover real business pain beneath surface-level inquiries, quantify its impact, and document it clearly for the AE.

  • Position ClickUp's platform and agentic AI capabilities credibly and specifically, mapping them to the prospect's actual workflow gaps.

  • Use AI tools across your entire workflow: account and persona research, personalization at scale, call prep, follow-up drafting, and CRM hygiene. Edit every output for authenticity, never ship raw.

  • Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead interactions and qualification status in CRM.

  • Deliver comprehensive AE handoffs with a qualification summary, roles identified, pain documented, and competitive context.

  • Provide detailed feedback to sales and marketing on lead quality, content effectiveness, and channel performance, helping refine messaging and targeting.

  • Occasionally perform cold outreach as needed, with a primary focus on inbound.

  • Share what works: talk tracks, AI workflows, and objection patterns. Individual wins are good, team adoption is better.

Qualifications

This role is built for a highly motivated and tenacious individual who is eager to succeed and thrives on hard work. The most important qualifications are your personal drive and resilience, as you'll be connecting with a high volume of customers daily.

  • What's non-negotiable: a strong work ethic, the grit to overcome challenges, and the tenacity to consistently engage with customers.

  • Also non-negotiable: genuine curiosity about AI and a willingness to rebuild how you work around it. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first and figures it out.

  • 1-2 years of relevant experience in outbound sales and/or a demonstrated passion for sales as a primary career focus.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to quickly build rapport and trust.

  • Analytical mindset with real attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools.

  • Collaborative team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving. AI adoption spreads through people who are approachable and generous with what they learn.

Success Metrics

  • Speed and quality of lead follow-up against SLA.

  • Conversion rate of MQLs to sales-qualified opportunities.

  • CRM data integrity and process adherence.

  • Quality and usefulness of feedback provided to marketing and sales.

  • Contribution to pipeline and revenue growth from marketing-generated leads.

The throughline for this role: speed, resilience, and conversion quality. You win by out-hustling, out-persisting, and out-qualifying every single day, and by using AI to make every one of those things easier than it was yesterday.

jobs.title: GRC Engineer
jobs.description:
GRC Engineer

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

The GRC Engineer will play a key role in running and scaling Fever's security compliance programme. You will turn compliance from manual, point-in-time exercises into automated, continuously monitored controls, while running several audits in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS and others) and keeping them on time.

This role is "engineer-first" and also delivery-focused. You will work with engineering, security, privacy, finance and business teams to translate requirements into technical controls, build automated evidence collection, assess our vendors, answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs, and manage the compliance projects from start to finish across the Fever group companies.

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. This is an opportunity to have a real impact as a high-growth global category leader.

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, audit calendar and compliance roadmap.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will support SOC 2 initiatives: scope, control set, gap remediation and readiness for the observation period.
  • You will build automated evidence collection workflows using our compliance platform, AI and scripting.
  • You will run audit requests and auditor follow-ups for the ongoing certifications.
  • You will run vendor security assessments and answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will lead the SOC 2 audit with the external auditor, coordinating control owners across the company.
  • You will manage several compliance projects in parallel, with clear milestones, owners and reporting to leadership.
  • You will create a knowledge base and answer library that speeds up questionnaires, RFPs and partner reviews.
  • You will embed compliance checks and telemetry into a standardised GRC platform for continuous control monitoring.

Key responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Type II readiness, observation period and audit, and keep the controls operating effectively afterwards.
  • Participate in multiple audits and certifications in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS), coordinating evidence, auditors and control owners.
  • Translate requirements into technical controls and build automated evidence collection and continuous control monitoring.
  • Run the third-party risk management process: vendor security assessments, due diligence, risk ratings and follow-up.
  • Manage responses to customer and partner security questionnaires, RFPs and security assessments.
  • Plan and execute compliance projects end to end, reporting status and risks to leadership.
  • Automate compliance checks on AI governance and enablement.
  • Improve key information security processes, including risk management, policies and security awareness.

About you

Must have:

  • Hands-on experience preparing for and running SOC 2 Type II audits, from scoping to final report.
  • Experience managing international audits and certifications (ISO 27001, PCI DSS or similar).
  • Proven experience in vendor security assessments and answering security questionnaires and RFPs.
  • Programming/scripting/AI skills (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) and experience building API integrations to automate evidence gathering.
  • Strong project management skills: planning, prioritisation and stakeholder follow-up across teams.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in GRC Engineering, Security Compliance or Security Engineering in a cloud-native company.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, AWS security or equivalent.
  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g. Vanta, Drata) and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive compliance tasks.
  • Experience with AI risk governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

Senior Technical Program Manager

About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) with experience in the IT industry—ideally working with or for major technology vendors and infrastructure providers. The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of hardware solutions and a foundational understanding of infrastructure data center build projects, including how engineering, construction, operations, and IT come together to deliver complex systems.

In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, construction, operations, IT, and commercial organizations to drive clarity, alignment, and momentum across highly technical and interdependent workstreams. You will serve as the connective tissue between disciplines—building trust, ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles, and driving a unified vision for program success.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You will help implement scalable processes and systems while also being comfortable rolling up your sleeves to establish baseline workflows, often using short-term manual approaches before automation or tooling is implemented.

jobs.title: Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)
jobs.description:
Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)

Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Team Overview

Deepgram recently opened its APAC headquarters in Singapore, and the region is one of our fastest-moving markets. You’ll build the APAC marketing function from zero, partnering closely with the APAC GM and regional sales leadership to shape and execute the regional plan. As part of the global Events & Field Marketing team, you’ll get the playbooks, brand assets, budget framework and coaching to help you move fast.

Your job is to make Deepgram visible and credible across the region through technical community and partner motions, and to turn that presence into pipeline. As the senior marketer in region, you're also marketing's local point of contact: you'll work with our APAC PR agency and partner with global Brand, Web, and Product Marketing to keep regional messaging local and consistent.

Key Goals

  • Ship an APAC field and events plan and budget, agreed with regional sales leadership, with reserve held for in-quarter opportunities

  • Launch a recurring technical community program out of Singapore, India, and Australia, with steady attendance from developers, builders and customers

  • Stand up repeatable joint field programs with cloud, technology, and channel partners, each with shared pipeline goals and tracking

  • Grow program-sourced and program-influenced pipeline and new logos across APAC

  • Localize global "event-in-a-box" kits for priority markets and follow up with every lead fast

  • Put a live APAC customer proof library (stories, case studies, references) into active use by sales aligned to global Marketing Team.

  • Work with global Brand Team to properly represent APAC on the website: a regional landing page, local customer logos, case studies, proof points, product news and team presence.

  • Deliver executive roundtables, customer dinners, and sponsorships, on time and on budget, reporting spend, attendance, and pipeline against plan

Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities

  • Plans and runs field and event programs end to end, from small executive dinners to large sponsorships, on time and on budget

  • Builds community technical audiences choose to attend: hands-on content, credible speakers, and real builders in the room

  • Designs partner marketing motions (joint programs, co-marketing, co-sell) with shared goals and measurable pipeline

  • Partners with sales to tie every program in the quarterly plan to pipeline

  • Adapts global playbooks to local markets across language, culture, format, and buyer expectations, and knows the APAC vendor landscape

  • Operates AI-native: designs Human+AI workflows for planning, logistics, follow-up, and reporting, and builds systems that eliminate recurring event work instead of redoing it each time

  • Works self-directed as the first in region, across time zones with a US-based team; travels across the region regularly (roughly 30-40%)

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have, not required)

  • Typically ~3–6 years in field or event marketing covering APAC, or equivalent demonstrated experience

  • Background in B2B SaaS, developer-focused, or AI/infrastructure marketing

  • Co-marketing experience with technical partners

  • Experience working with PR agencies or supporting regional communications

  • Professional proficiency in an additional regional language (e.g., Bahasa, Mandarin)

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

About the Client & the Project

Our client is a global cybersecurity services and solutions provider helping government organisations, critical infrastructure providers, and businesses protect their operations against increasingly complex cyber threats.

The company brings together expertise in cybersecurity consulting, security monitoring, threat intelligence, technical security solutions, and incident response. Its mission is to help organisations strengthen their cyber resilience, minimise the impact of security incidents, and ensure effective recovery.

With an established international presence and a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity professionals, the company is expanding its incident management capabilities.

The Incident Management function focuses on delivering a coordinated response to major cybersecurity incidents, combining technical investigations, operational coordination, crisis management, and strategic decision-making.

About the Role

As a Cyber Incident Commander, you will lead and coordinate the response to complex cybersecurity incidents, bringing together technical specialists, operational teams, and business stakeholders to ensure effective investigation, containment, remediation, and recovery.

This newly established leadership role offers an opportunity to shape incident response operations, manage and mentor cybersecurity specialists, and contribute to the continuous development of the company’s global incident management capabilities.

You will work closely with international teams and external stakeholders, combining strong technical cybersecurity expertise with leadership, crisis management, and decision-making skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the response to major cybersecurity incidents, ensuring timely investigation, containment, mitigation, and resolution.

  • Manage and mentor a team of incident responders and technical specialists.

  • Coordinate technical, operational, and strategic response activities throughout the incident lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with specialists in threat attribution, cyber investigations, and incident mitigation.

  • Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement agencies, national CERTs, and regulatory bodies.

  • Act as the central point of coordination during cyber crises, ensuring effective communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Develop and refine incident response procedures, playbooks, and escalation protocols.

  • Collaborate with international incident management teams to ensure consistent practices and knowledge sharing across regions.

  • Conduct post-incident analysis and reporting, identifying lessons learned and areas for improvement.

  • Support the development of Security Operations Centre (SOC) capabilities and other cybersecurity functions as required.

  • Contribute to threat intelligence initiatives and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • Proven experience in cybersecurity incident response and crisis management.

  • Strong technical background in cybersecurity, with the ability to understand, oversee, and guide technical investigations.

  • Experience working within international organisations and managing cross-border cybersecurity incidents.

  • Strong leadership experience, with the ability to manage and coordinate technical specialists and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international colleagues.

  • Willingness to travel internationally.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to remain effective under pressure and lead during critical situations.

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.

  • Collaborative mindset and adaptability in a fast-paced, international environment.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience managing complex or high-impact cybersecurity incidents.

  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cyber crisis simulations or tabletop exercises.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and digital forensic tools.

jobs.title: Community Field Strategist - Ireland
jobs.description:
Community Field Strategist - Ireland

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Community

Location: Remote Ireland

Compensation Range: €76,000 to €86,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.

You are Outcome-Obsessed about creating meaningful engagements at events from the moment you leave your house to the moment you return, knowing that booth hours are just the tip of the iceberg. You make sure the right prospects receive thoughtful follow-up, account executives get the context they need, and qualified conversations become fully booked demo opportunities. You take ownership of the details, spot what is missing, and use sound judgment when the process needs to bend to serve the customer and the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Travel to assigned roadshows, tradeshows, and other events up to 60% of the time while representing Huntress with energy, professionalism, and a clear understanding of the audience.
  • Drive meaningful traffic to the Huntress booth with pre-event outreach, and by starting conversations, engaging attendees, and creating reasons for the right people to stop and learn more.
  • Execute on-site activations and feet-on-the-street account-based marketing activities as directed by your manager.
  • Build genuine relationships with prospects and partners, in transit, in hallways, over drinks, over dinner, at the booth, at event receptions and parties. Wherever the MSPs are, that’s where you’ll be found.
  • Drive interest through thoughtful conversation, and book demos at in-person events.
  • Manage event follow-up and relationship progression so account executives receive timely context, clear next steps, and strong opportunities to pursue.
  • Use AI tools to research target accounts, prepare for conversations, organize event notes, and draft timely follow-up while applying sound judgment to the final work.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Experience engaging prospects at tradeshows, roadshows, conferences, or other in-person events is valuable.
  • You are curious, self-starting, eager to learn, driven, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You can engage strangers naturally, make small talk that leads somewhere useful, and build relationships without making the interaction feel transactional.
  • You are travel-ready and comfortable working in environments that require frequent movement, quick judgment, and consistent energy.
  • You are detail-oriented and able to follow a process while recognizing when the situation calls for a thoughtful deviation.
  • You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day preparation, research, and follow-up, with good judgment about accuracy, privacy, and when human context matters most.

Willkommen bei Western Union Retail Services Deutschland GmbH!

Als Teil eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Geldtransfer und Finanzdienstleistungen tragen wir dazu bei, dass Menschen rund um den Globus sicher, schnell und zuverlässig Geld bewegen können. Unsere tägliche Arbeit verbindet internationale Reichweite mit lokalem Service – und dafür brauchen wir Menschen wie Dich.

Aufgaben

Als Kundenberater (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Betreuung unserer Kunden und tragen gleichzeitig zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf in der Filiale bei. Sie unterstützen unsere Kunden bei Geldtransfer- und Währungsgeschäften und sorgen für eine sichere, zuverlässige und positive Kundenerfahrung.

  • Öffnen und Schließen der Filiale gemäß den geltenden Betriebsabläufen
  • Durchführung von Geldtransfergeschäften präzise, sicher und effizient
  • Bearbeitung von Bargeldein- und -auszahlungen mit hoher Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit

  • Sorgfältige Dokumentation von Transaktionen sowie Durchführung des täglichen Kassenabschlusses
  • Erstellung und Übermittlung von Berichten an die Filial- und Regionalleitung nach Bedarf
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien, Prozesse und regulatorischer Anforderungen
  • Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Risiko- und Betriebsstandards nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der erforderlichen Schulungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung lokaler Marketingaktivitäten und Werbeaktionen in der Filiale

Arbeitszeitmodell

100 % VOR ORT – Western Union schätzt die persönliche Zusammenarbeit, den direkten Austausch und die gemeinsame Entwicklung von Ideen. Aufgrund der Art dieser Position wird die Tätigkeit vollständig vor Ort in der Filiale ausgeübt.

  • Vollzeitstelle (40 Stunden pro Woche)
  • Fünf-Tage-Woche von Montag bis Samstag
  • Schichtmodell mit monatlicher Einsatzplanung für mehr Transparenz und eine bessere
  • Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben
  • 25 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

Eine Beschäftigung in Teilzeit kann – abhängig vom betrieblichen Bedarf und Ihrer Verfügbarkeit – ebenfalls möglich sein.

Qualifikation

  • Erste Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe, Finanzdienstleistungssektor oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld ist von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil (z. B. Türkisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Afrikaans oder andere Sprachen)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office und weiteren gängigen Computeranwendungen
  • Freundliches, professionelles und kundenorientiertes Auftreten
  • Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu koordinieren und auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick zu behalten
  • Hohe Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit im Umgang mit Bargeldtransaktionen
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis und Bereitschaft, die erforderlichen Hintergrundprüfungen zu durchlaufen

Benefits

Zusätzlich profitieren Sie von leistungsabhängigen Bonuszahlungen, einer vollständig finanzierten betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie dem Zugang zu erstklassigen Lern- und Entwicklungsplattformen. Nachfolgend finden Sie die Benefits für Deutschland. Weitere positionsspezifische Vorteile werden, sofern zutreffend, im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses oder im Rahmen eines Angebots erläutert.

Ihre Benefits in Deutschland umfassen:

  • Attraktives Grundgehalt mit Bonusmöglichkeit – ganz ohne aktive Vertriebsziele
  • Essensgutscheine
  • Kostenfreie Getränke
  • Steuerfreie Sachbezüge
  • Eine unterstützende Unternehmenskultur, die auf Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitigem Respekt basiert
  • Mitarbeiter-Challenges und Anerkennungsprogramme
  • Umfassende Einarbeitung und Schulungen – ideal auch für Quereinsteiger und Kandidaten ohne Vorkenntnisse im Finanzdienstleistungsbereich
  • Arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Wir setzen uns dafür ein, die Individualität unserer Mitarbeitenden wertzuschätzen und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder zugehörig fühlt. Unser Ziel ist eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur, die die vielfältigen Hintergründe und Perspektiven unserer globalen Teams fördert und gleichzeitig die Gemeinschaften widerspiegelt, die wir weltweit unterstützen. Wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, nationaler Herkunft, Religion, politischer Überzeugung, Geschlecht (einschließlich Schwangerschaft), sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Behinderung, Familienstand oder Veteranenstatus. Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern, einschließlich Menschen mit Behinderungen, stellen wir im Einklang mit den geltenden gesetzlichen Bestimmungen angemessene Unterstützung während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive - DACH (m/f/d)

Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the role

At Tandem Health, we’re building a clinician copilot that gives time back to care teams so clinicians can focus on patients. As a Senior Account Executive m/f/d, you’ll turn thoughtful research and crisp outreach into momentum by opening the right doors, surfacing real problems, and setting up conversations that change how care is delivered. You’ll help define our outbound voice and playbooks with a bias for speed to impact, craft that delights, and radical transparency. You’ll work closely with clinicians and product so every meeting speaks to real workflows and outcomes. As our European footprint expands, this role can grow into leadership as we scale the commercial team.

 

What you will do

  • Own a defined geographic territory and build strong, trusted relationships with healthcare professionals through consistent on-site presence.

  • Lead the discovery, solution positioning, and objection handling.

  • Understand practitioners’ workflows and tailor solutions that help them save time, reduce administrative burden, improve visibility, and enhance patient care.

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Sales leadership to refine messaging, share field insights, and improve go-to-market playbooks.

 

What you bring

  • Initial experience in sales, business development, or customer-facing roles, ideally involving field prospecting, outbound activity, or direct client interaction.

  • Strong motivation for sales and comfort working toward objectives, with the resilience to handle rejection and maintain momentum.

  • Ability to manage a full sales cycle with guidance: from first contact and discovery to closing and onboarding.

  • Interest in healthcare, digital products, or technology that improves professional workflows and has a positive societal impact.

  • A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a strong desire to learn and grow within a scaling commercial team.

  • Bilingual fluency in both German and English

 

Bonus points

  • Previous experience in field sales, door-to-door prospecting, or territory-based commercial roles.

  • Experience selling to healthcare professionals (clinics, private practices, care providers) or working in regulated environments.

  • Experience in digital products, SaaS, or technology that improves professional workflows.

 

Location

While we believe great ideas thrive through in-person collaboration, this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, with occasional travel to our Munich office.

 

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

 

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Sales team member

  3. Second interview with our Country Director for Germany

  4. Working Day - Join us in the Munich office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Vicos consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. We are scaling our go-to-market, AI-first and human-led: AI takes over the busywork, people build the relationships and make the decisions. For that we look for people with a builder’s mindset: you have already built or significantly contributed to something, you work with AI as naturally as with email, and you want to grow fast. Maybe you want to found your own company one day.

jobs.description:
Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager

The Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager owns the standard, performance and quality of the Autoreverse process, from vehicle receipt through initial disassembly and handover to downstream activities. 

The role supports the four Operations sites, works daily with the Operations Managers and interfaces with the Product Manager to ensure that process, quality and product requirements are aligned. The objective is to deliver a safe, repeatable and scalable process for the A2MAC1 Data Factory. 

The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures. 

As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to: 

  • Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites. 
  • Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery. 
  • Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation. 
  • Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites. 
  • Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030. 

RESPONSABILITIES 

1. Process Standards and Methods 

  • Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model. 
  • Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites. 
  • Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined. 
  • Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow. 

2. Quality and Continuous Improvement 

  • Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality. 
  • Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing. 
  • Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites. 

3. Operations Performance 

  • Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle. 
  • Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps. 
  • Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites. 
  • Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis. 

4. International Coordination and Deployment 

  • Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites. 
  • Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking. 
  • Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites. 
  • Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up. 
  • Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard. 

5. Product and Industrialization Interface 

  • Work with the Product Manager to translate product and vehicle evolution into operational process requirements. 
  • Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality. 
  • Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives. 
  • Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment. 

6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution 

  • Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager. 
  • Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse. 
  • Support POQs and improvement initiatives that can be standardized and deployed across the four sites. 
  • Provide operational feedback on automation, digitalization and Data Factory initiatives. 

7. Team Capability, Safety and Governance 

  • Train and coach teams on standard work, quality requirements and safe operating practices. 
  • Develop competency assessments and practical onboarding for critical Autoreverse activities. 
  • Identify process, quality and safety risks and coordinate mitigation actions. 
  • Maintain clear documentation and ensure that process changes are communicated and implemented. 

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS 

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations management or a related discipline. 
  • Professional background: Approximately 5 years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, industrial operations, quality or process improvement. 
  • Experience in a hands-on production, workshop, laboratory or technical operating environment. 
  • Experience with quality tools, process audits, structured problem solving and corrective action plans. 
  • Experience coordinating improvement activities across several teams or sites is preferred. 
  • International exposure: Experience working with multicultural teams or across multiple operating locations. 
  • Lean, Six Sigma, quality or project management certification is an advantage. 

SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong quality and continuous improvement mindset, with practical root-cause and corrective-action experience.

jobs.description:
Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems.

  • Kinematics Power Sizing: Size and integrate high-acceleration hydraulic, pneumatic, or spring-loaded actuation systems, high-speed release mechanisms, and custom dampening systems capable of handling extreme dynamic loads.

  • Autonomous Launch Operations: Design reliable mechanical systems capable of operating independently in harsh, remotely supervised environments—handling self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and system resets.

  • Structural Engineering & Validation: Perform hand calculations and FEA to size heavy-duty structural weldments and moving assemblies, accounting for weld fatigue, shock, and sudden violent loads.

  • Testing & Prototyping: Build custom test benches and field rigs to validate designs, running physical stress tests to failure and iterating rapidly on hardware.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Flight Dynamics to define launch requirements, and work alongside Hardware and Embedded Software engineers to synchronize mechanical actuation with automated launch code.

  • Supplier & Project Ownership: Manage project budgets, timelines, and technical documentation (2D/3D CAD, BOMs, test reports) while partnering with suppliers on heavy-precision machining and series production.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Mechanical & Structural Design: Proven track record designing large-scale, heavily loaded machinery, structural weldments, and rugged mechanisms from scratch (ideally in aerospace, defense, heavy equipment, or robotics).

  • Kinematics Expertise: Deep hands-on experience sizing and designing moving assemblies, high-speed release mechanisms, and pneumatic or hydraulic circuits (cylinders, accumulators, valves) under high-acceleration forces.

  • CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases.

  • Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests.

  • Communication & Mission Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication to document complex engineering decisions, paired with full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, pace, and growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
