jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Onboarding Manager

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our Customer Success team is seeking a Customer Onboarding Manager for the UK market. In this role, you’ll be responsible for guiding customers through every step of setting up, integrating and activating our platform. Working with Sales, CSM and Product, you’ll play a key part in increasing customer loyalty and satisfaction, ensuring new customers experience the full value and benefits of our product for their business operations.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Customer Understanding - Partner with the Sales team to understand the customer needs and objectives. Work closely with customers to clarify requirements and timelines to tailor the onboarding plan.

  • Strategic Onboarding Planning - Develop and continuously refine onboarding strategies and project plans outlining tasks, milestones, and timelines. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful customer activation and satisfaction.

  • Customer Guidance & Education - Serve as a key point of contact for customers throughout the onboarding process, providing expert guidance, support and documentation as needed. Address and resolve any issues or challenges that arise. Conduct training sessions for clients to ensure they are proficient in using the Moss platform.

  • Progress Monitoring & Reporting - Maintain client information up-to-date in CRM (Salesforce). Monitor and report on the progress of the onboarding process, identifying risks and obstacles and developing solutions to overcome them.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams within the company to escalate and resolve technical issues. Drive initiatives for continuous improvement, gathering feedback from customers and sharing it with internal teams to enhance the overall onboarding process.

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role:

  • Proven experience in an onboarding, implementation, support, or project management position, involving direct customer engagement with finance professionals.

  • A solid understanding of accounting principles and practices.

  • You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Complex Problem Solver - You’re able to find solutions to even the most complex problems, breaking them down into manageable components and developing original and effective solutions. You address issues promptly, and adapt strategies in response to changing priorities and needs.

  • Data-driven Strategist - You have a data-driven, structured and solution-oriented way of working, enabling you to juggle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. You leverage data to prioritize customer portfolios and internal tasks, ensuring the quality and impact of your work.

  • Domain Expert - You have a good understanding of finance and accounting, but you’re always curious and eager to deepen your knowledge of the product and the domain. You proactively seek learning resources, keep up-to-date on industry trends and connect with other experts. As the go-to person on all things onboarding and accounting related, you enjoy discussing product feedback and improvements internally.

  • Customer Focused - You demonstrate empathy and credibility in customer discussions about their needs, making them feel understood and heard. You’re able to adapt your communication to different audiences, from finance leaders to external accountants, allowing you to build trusting customer relationships.

  • Team Player - You contribute to the Moss culture and ways of working by promoting collaboration, learning, and growth across peers and leaders. With a low ego and open communication, you collaborate across all teams, helping outside of your own scope when needed, and respectfully giving transparent feedback.

  • Ownership - You independently execute end-to-end onboarding projects, from the Sales’ handover to the transition to CSM/CS and beyond. You show persistence, accountability and initiative across every aspect of your work, from achieving customer activation goals by consistently following up on customer communications, to driving your own learning and development.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Development Representative - 4 Day Week + Remote

Still get a buzz from a cold call? Good. So do we. 

Our SDRs call commercial, project and operations leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms. They're busy, they're blunt, and they've heard every software pitch going (some of them twice before lunch). Earn their two minutes, find a genuine problem on a live project, and you'll hand over a meeting your Account Executive can actually win. 

You've done this before, so you know a full calendar isn't the same as a good one. Here, quality wins every time, and you'll have a playbook that works, coaching from people who know construction, and a team that backs you to do it properly. 

If you want your experience to count for more than your dial count, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) 

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction! 

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION 

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. 

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it). 

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. 

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech 

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. 

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 

4 core values for a good life 

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: 

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world 

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. 

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: 

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

You're where every Shape deal starts, and one of the people who sets the standard for how we prospect. As you grow, you'll shape our messaging and set the bar for the SDRs who join after you. 

 

What the job actually is 

You know the job. Most of your day is on the phone, and you'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" more than anything else. Here, you'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself.

You also know that to be good at cold calling, you have to genuinely love it. If you don't, and you plan to go through the motions, it's a boring job, and it shows on every call. We're looking for someone who still gets a buzz from turning a cold "who's this?" into a real conversation.

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we want people who feel the same. You'll know a booked meeting isn't the same as a good one. Here, it means understanding their problem properly: being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and knowing by the end of the call what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. It also means only offering a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having.

 

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell.

 

Where you'll work

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future.

 

Why it's worth it 

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. 

 

Your top responsibilities 

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.
  • Raise the bar: once you're up to speed, share what's working, contribute to the playbook and help newer SDRs get better faster.
 
Your roadmap: your first 30 days and beyond 

You bring the experience. We'll make sure you're selling the Shape way, with confidence, by week 3 or 4. 

  • Before day 1, ready to go: your CRM, dialler, call recording and your own Shape login set up, so week 1 is spent learning.
  • Week 1, understand the why: the problems we solve, who for, and why it beats how contractors work today, with the product shown in action by Customer Success.
  • Week 2, build your pitch: write your first-call pitch, compare it with the winning calls in our library, get it reviewed, and make your first live calls if you're ready.
  • Weeks 3–4, up and running: calling daily with call reviews, booking your first meetings and handing them over properly.
  • By day 30: signed off as ready to call, every call in the library listened to, and your first measures reviewed with your manager.
  • Months 2–3, ramp: half the full target, with your own quality scorecard.
  • By the end of month 3, full target: the same target every SDR carries, in line with your probation period.
  • 6–12 months, step up: own a set of key accounts or a segment, help refine our messaging and set the bar for newer SDRs, with a clear path to Account Executive or SDR Team Lead.

 

Why three months is realistic: it's quick by industry standards, and that's deliberate. You won't be figuring it out alone. You'll have a playbook built from calls that have won, regular call reviews, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. Training never stops at day 30, however experienced you are. 

 

How you'll be measured

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having? 

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week. 

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics. 

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there. 

 

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next.

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way.

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

 

Your Capabilities

Must haves:

  • Proven outbound experience at a senior level: 2+ years of phone-led B2B prospecting into directors and heads of department, in a complex sale where several people are involved in each decision and sales cycles are longer.
  • A track record: you've been at or above target for most of the last 12 months, and you can show it.
  • Your own toughest critic: you can listen back to your own call and say what worked, what didn't and what you'd change.
  • A forever learner: however good you get, you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it. 

What we look for in you 

  • Numbers-obsessed: you know why your numbers are what they are: not just dials and meetings booked, but how many showed, how many qualified and what you changed when one dipped.
  • Quality over volume: you'd choose a better conversation over a faster one. You test the problem before you pitch and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Quick on your feet, and a genuine listener: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and listen to understand. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • A strategist who takes action: you plan who to call, when and why, run your own day and keep your CRM honest. Then you act, without waiting to be told.
  • You've done your homework: you understand the problems construction teams face, and you can say clearly why construction and why this job.
  • A sponge, with no ego: however good you are, you soak up how we do things here and take feedback on your calls. Egos stay at the door, on both sides. 

Why experience alone isn't enough 

Experience gets you an interview, but it isn't what gets you the job. We've seen numbers-first sales cultures produce full calendars and empty pipelines, so we're looking for experience that's still coachable. 

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining) 

  • Experience selling into construction, engineering or infrastructure.
  • Having helped build or improve a playbook, sequence or messaging.
  • Start-up or scale-up experience.
  • Experience managing your own pipeline in a CRM and using diallers and other sales tools.
  • Construction site experience, or time working in the industry.
  • Full-cycle (360) sales experience, from first call through to close.

 Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: 

  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

 

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. 
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. 
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions:
  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's the number you're most proud of from your current or last role, and why? 

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate. 

What happens next 

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages: 

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

FP&A Lead

What is the job?

This is a rare opportunity to help lead FP&A at a pivotal stage in our growth. You will build on the foundations already in place, bringing commercial insight, structure and ambition to how we plan, forecast and make decisions across Montu’s European businesses.

You will be a trusted partner to leaders across Commercial, Marketing, Technology and the wider business. Your insight will directly shape strategic decisions, investment priorities and business performance at leadership level.

With significant scope to influence how the function evolves, this role also offers a clear path to building and leading an FP&A team as the business continues to scale.

 

What you will own?

Financial Planning & Modelling

  • Set the financial planning cadence for expansion regions, owning and continuously evolving the models that underpin scenario planning and three-way modelling.

  • Lead aspects of the annual budgeting cycle and regular re-forecasts end-to-end, setting a high standard for how the business plans internationally.

  • Collaboratively lead annual budget processes across Europe

  • Support long-term planning and investment decisions with robust commercial modelling and business case development.

Performance & Insight

  • Act as the senior finance partner to functional leads, translating numbers into insight and holding leadership teams accountable to budgets and OKRs

  • Identify the story behind the numbers and use it to influence strategic direction, not just report on it

Tooling & Infrastructure

  • Own the roadmap for financial planning and reporting infrastructure across the business

  • Work with the Data & Analytics team to automate reporting and improve the quality, speed, and accessibility of financial data across the business

  • Bring a continuous improvement mindset - spotting opportunities for better process, tooling, and reporting before they become bottlenecks

Leadership & Influence

  • Help to build the FP&A team as the function scales

  • Act as a senior commercial partner and advisor to leaders across the business, including at board level

  • Set the standards, governance, and processes this function will run on long-term

  • Represent Finance in strategic, board, and investor-facing discussions

 

What we are looking for

  • Extensive experience (typically 8+ years) in FP&A, commercial finance, or business partnering, including experience operating at senior/leadership level in a fast-paced or scaling environment

  • Fully ACA, CIMA, ACCA qualified (or equivalent), with advanced financial modelling and planning expertise

  • Demonstrated experience building and owning complex forecasts, including three-way financial models, from scratch

  • Proven experience building an FP&A function or reporting infrastructure - this is essential, not a plus

  • A genuinely commercial, board-ready mindset - curious about the whole business, not just Finance

  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence and build trust with senior leadership and board members

  • Comfort with significant ambiguity and a track record of taking full ownership in high-growth, evolving environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience in high-volume D2C or tech-enabled businesses

  • Experience supporting fundraising, board reporting, or investor relations

  • Experience selecting and implementing FP&A or reporting tools/platforms

 

Why This Role?

  • Genuine ownership - you're not inheriting a function, you're building one

  • Visibility - direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making from day one

  • Growth - a clear path to building and leading a team as FP&A scales with the business

  • Impact - your models and insight will directly shape how the company plans, invests, and grows

 

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays.

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions.

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more.

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact.

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave.

Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre

Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Saturday 5th December, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

  • Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience

  • Opportunities for training and professional development

  • Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment

  • The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare

  • The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Join Us?

Assessment Centre: Saturday 5th December

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre.

Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day.

Business Operations (Revenue & GTM)

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your Mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which the sales team has tripled in size and increased ARR per sales rep by 50% (from €400K to €600K).

To achieve this, you own Business & Revenue Operations end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Ops, Finance and Product. You report to Robin, Head of RevOps, and work hand in hand with the Head of Sales, your main internal client.

Beyond the revenue engine, you are the go-to partner of leadership on revenue decisions: segmentation and targeting, pricing, sales capacity planning, and the operational setup of our US expansion. You turn ambiguous questions into structured, data-backed recommendations, then you build the solution yourself.

This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role. You define the strategy, build, run, document and iterate.

Responsibilities

Sales & GTM Ops

  • Own the CRM (Attio): pipeline structure, stages, fields, hygiene

  • Define and track funnel metrics (SQL, win rate, cycle length, ARR)

  • Build deal workflows, pricing logic and approvals

  • Support sales with clean data, dashboards and forecasts

  • Instrument meetings, calls, emails and demos in the CRM

  • Define activity standards, ensure data completeness, provide visibility on activity vs results

  • Implement compensation rules as the single source of truth; automate calculations, reporting and payout exports; make sure numbers are clear, trusted and undisputed

  • Own the sales tool stack (demo platform, telephony, call recording, integrations): reliability, adoption and proper usage across the team

Onboarding & Delivery Ops

  • Structure deployment workflows (from signed deal to live)

  • Track time-to-live, blockers and handoffs

  • Standardize configs, templates and playbooks

Billing & Revenue

  • Own the contracts → billing → cash collection flow

  • Work with tools like Hyperline, Stripe and invoicing

  • Track MRR, ARR, churn, expansion and cohorts

  • Ensure pricing is applied correctly (per site, per provider, per call)

Revenue Analytics & Strategic Projects

  • Build weekly and monthly revenue dashboards

  • Track unit economics (ARPA, gross margin, CAC, LTV)

  • Lead ad hoc analyses for leadership: market segmentation, territory design, pricing, capacity planning

  • Surface issues early. No surprises.

Process & Documentation

  • Write everything down (Notion)

  • Create SOPs so the company doesn’t rely on tribal knowledge

  • Make the org scalable from [25] to 100+ people

 

This role is for you if

  • 3–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

  • Fluent in French, Professional English

 

Benefits

Recruitment process

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

Context

We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, our SDR and AE team keeps growing and every rep has to go faster, not just work harder. Today, prospecting still relies on individual initiative: each rep builds and enriches lists their own way. That’s what this role fixes.

 

Your mission

Every SDR starts the day with the right accounts, the right contacts, the right trigger and the right message, without building a list by hand. Every inbound lead reaches the right SDR fast, with its context. You build and run the system that makes this true, in France first, then in the US.

You report to Robin, Head of RevOps. Your main internal clients are the SDRs and the Sales team, and you work hand in hand with Marketing on inbound.

This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role: you define the approach, build the workflows, run them and iterate.

 

Responsibilities

Data & Enrichment

  • Build and own the enrichment system: the right source for each field, fallbacks, deduplication, data quality metrics

  • Take over the data foundation currently being built with an external partner (CRM cleanup, market mapping, scoring) and turn it into pipeline

  • Define ICP scoring and qualification criteria with Sales leadership

  • Deliver lists SDRs can act on immediately

Signals & Outbound

  • Identify the events that make an account worth contacting now (new practitioners or sites, tools in place, hiring, closed-lost deals to reactivate…) and wire them into scoring and routing

  • Own the outbound stack: sequencing tool, deliverability (domains, warm-up, sending limits), multichannel sequences triggered by signals

  • Use AI to personalise at scale, with guardrails

  • Set clear handoff rules from reply to SDR

Inbound & Attribution

  • Build lead capture and routing with Marketing: qualification, spam filtering, pre-enrichment, routing to the right SDR

  • Track speed-to-lead and alert when leads wait

  • Keep source and campaign attribution clean from first touch to signed deal, so Marketing and Sales read the same funnel

SDR Enablement

  • Build the SDR cockpit in Attio and the SDR playbook

  • Help new SDRs ramp in weeks, not months

  • Give visibility on activity and conversion per rep

  • Sit with SDRs, listen to calls, and ship small apps and automations that remove clicks

What this is NOT

  • Not a campaign operator role: you build the engine, you don’t just press send

  • Not a data analyst role: dashboards serve decisions, not decoration

  • Not SDR management: Sales leadership manages and coaches the team, you build what they run on

Expected outcomes

30 days

  • Audit of enrichment, lists, sequences and the SDR day, with frictions ranked by cost

  • First enrichment wave shipped: every SDR has their own list

  • Inbound flow mapped with Marketing: sources, routing, where leads leak or wait

  • Roadmap agreed with Sales leadership and Marketing

3 months

  • Enrichment running inside Attio, scoring live

  • First signals wired into sequences, in France and the US

  • Sequencing tool live, deliverability monitored

  • SDR cockpit and playbook adopted by the team

  • Inbound routing automated, speed-to-lead tracked

  • Every workflow documented

6 months

  • Lists arrive pre-enriched with reliable emails and phone numbers

  • Signal-driven outbound is the default motion in France and the US

  • A new SDR is productive within weeks

  • Meetings and pipeline measurable per rep, channel and source, from first touch to signed deal

Why join now

You’re our first GTM Engineer: a blank page and a direct impact on revenue you can measure every week. We are [25] today and hiring [40] people in [2027]. The engine you build is what the whole sales team will run on, in France and in the US.

 

This role is for you if

  • You have 3–5 years in GTM Engineering, Growth Ops, Sales Ops or RevOps with a strong outbound component, in B2B SaaS or a startup

  • You’ve built outbound systems end to end yourself, deliverability included

  • You’ve set up inbound routing and conversion tracking with a Marketing team

  • You’re hands-on with a CRM (Attio, HubSpot or Salesforce), enrichment and sequencing tools, and n8n or equivalent. You’re comfortable with APIs, scripts and SQL, you use AI as a co-pilot, and you have no developer ego

  • You’re obsessed with data quality, not data quantity, and you take GDPR seriously

  • You’re comfortable working directly with founders and owning a system end to end

  • You’re fluent in French and English

Nice to have: experience in healthtech or vertical SaaS selling to practices and clinics, US outbound, a Clay / Cargo / warehouse-backed GTM stack.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Senior Client Partner - Microsoft Advertising
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
 
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Driving Revenue Growth and Strategic Client Expansion

As a Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in driving commercial growth and expanding Aleph's footprint in Switzerland, directly contributing to revenue generation, portfolio expansion, and long-term strategic client partnerships.

This is a revenue-driven, commercially focused role. You will own a book of business, identify new growth opportunities, and position Aleph as a strategic partner within the Swiss digital advertising ecosystem.


What You Will Do

Revenue Growth and Portfolio Expansion

  • Sell Microsoft Advertising solutions to both new and existing advertisers.
  • Proactively generate new leads, build a robust sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records of all sales activities.
  • Consistently achieve sales targets while delivering a high-quality customer sales experience.
  • Accurately forecast weekly, monthly, and annual revenue performance.

    • Strategic Client Leadership

  • Build and maintain a strong network of contacts across key verticals through industry events, outreach, and market engagement.
  • Engage regularly with new and existing clients to understand campaign objectives, KPIs, and future marketing plans.
  • Recommend tailored solutions from the product portfolio to help clients achieve their business and marketing goals.
  • Lead onboarding processes for new clients, including guiding them through legal and compliance requirements.

    • Market and Cross-Functional Impact

  • Stay up to date with market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.
  • Introduce Aleph to new prospects and expand presence across target industries.
  • Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (Account Managers) to ensure smooth campaign launches and execution.
  • Provide timely, actionable feedback to clients to optimize performance and strengthen relationships.

    • What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of digital advertising experience, in business development, account management, key account management, or ad sales.
  • Strong understanding of the Swiss advertising ecosystem, with an established network across key industry players and stakeholders, particularly within media agencies, as well as advertisers and publishers.
  • Strong commercial skills, with direct responsibility for revenue.
  • Direct experience in paid search advertising (SEM), performance advertising, and e-commerce.
  • The ability to work independently and set your own workflows to achieve sales targets, including in a fully remote setup.
  • Right to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).
  • Fluency in French and English. French is a plus.

    • How Success Looks

    As a Senior Client Partner at Aleph, success means driving real business results for clients while making a measurable impact on the team and the company. You will know you are thriving when:

  • Clients trust you as a strategic partner, seeing tangible growth and measurable improvements in their campaigns and overall performance.
  • You consistently hit or exceed your individual revenue and performance targets while contributing to the collective goals of the team.
  • You identify opportunities for expansion, optimizing strategies and processes to deliver smarter, more efficient campaigns.
  • You actively bring in new clients and business opportunities, closing deals that fuel both client growth and Aleph's market expansion.
  • You actively collaborate, share knowledge, and bring innovative ideas that improve outcomes for clients and the team alike.

    • What You Get at Aleph
  • Impact: You will own a book of business and shape how Swiss advertisers use Microsoft Advertising, with results you can measure in revenue and client growth.
  • Growth: Move across teams, take on new responsibilities, and expand your expertise within a network that represents 55+ leading digital platforms.
  • Team culture: Join a collaborative, innovative team that encourages initiative, creativity, and ownership, and that welcomes people from every background.
  • Market context: Switzerland is a premium advertising market, worth CHF 4.1 billion in net advertising revenue in 2025, with online advertising as its largest segment.
  • Flexibility and wellbeing: Work fully remotely from Switzerland, with global exposure and a benefits package designed to support your personal development and quality of life.

    Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

jobs.description:
Product Engineer, AI (Junior to Mid-Level)

About us

At PastaHR, we're building the Agentic AI platform for enterprise recruiting teams.

Recruiters are drowning in applications, repetitive tasks, and manual processes. Meanwhile, agentic AI adoption in enterprise recruiting is still in its infancy. We're here to change that. Our platform integrates with existing applicant tracking systems like Workday and SAP, bringing AI-powered screening, scheduling, and custom AI agents into the workflows recruiters already use.

While other recruiting startups sell to startups, we bring AI into the real world. We serve enterprise customers across industries like retail, manufacturing, construction, logistics or financial services including companies like Aldi, Siemens, Swisscom or Vontobel.

We're a small, ambitious team with big goals.

Our team brings together people with strong backgrounds in technology, startups, and entrepreneurship. As a bootstrapped company, we grow through real commercial success. That means we're resourceful, move fast, and achieve a lot with a lean team.

At PastaHR, you'll take on real responsibility from day one, have a direct impact on our product and customers, and grow alongside the company. You'll be pushed outside your comfort zone, but you'll never be on your own.

If you thrive on ownership, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to build something that actually makes a difference, you'll feel right at home.

About the role

  • You will plan, build and ship AI-powered features and agents to be used by some of Europe's largest companies.

  • You will collaborate closely with our customers to improve and integrate AI agents into their daily workflows

  • Unlike at other companies, you will own projects end to end – even if as a junior (with the required support from the team)

  • You'll work across the stack, from frontend interfaces to AI agents and enterprise integrations, taking ownership from idea to production

Our tech stack:

  • Nextjs / React / Typescript / Shadcn / Tailwind/ AI SDKs / PostgreSQL / dbos

  • All the latest LLMs and Decision Models / Langfuse for observability and evals

  • Infra: AWS

What we're looking for

  • You must have finished your degree and are looking for a full-time position (this is not an internship).

  • You are a builder at heart. This means you built full-stack applications yourself and can showcase projects beyond university coursework.

  • You are highly skilled using AI coding agents. You use AI to move faster but take full responsibility for the code you ship.

  • You care deeply about user experience, have an eye for good design, and want to keep improving it.

  • You're curious, proactive, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

  • You have demonstrated ambition beyond academics through personal projects, internships, entrepreneurial ventures, or extracurricular activities.

  • You are willing to work in a hybrid setup with multiple days a week in our office in Zurich.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Experience with non-deterministic systems, especially LLM evaluations

  • Experience with durable execution frameworks such as dbos, Temporal etc.

  • Fluent in German (We work with companies in the DACH region, the better your German, the closer to the end user you can be.)

What we offer

  • Real ownership and impact from day one

  • Fast learning alongside experienced engineers and founders

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge AI and high token limits

  • Latest MacBook Pro

  • 26 vacation days per year (you can use flexibly)

PastaHR is for you, if:

  • You enjoy taking full ownership of your work and proactively driving topics forward.

  • You like working with the newest tools and finding the best solution to a problem.

  • You’re eager to learn quickly, grow in your role, and evolve with the company.

  • You want to help shape the company and see the real impact of your work.

PastaHR is not for you, if:

  • You don't want a challenge, learn a ton and grow with the company.

  • You need clear structures in the team and a lot of guidance.

  • Your preferred work environment consists primarily of remote work/home office.

  • You are in search of a more laid-back workplace.

The process

  1. Introduction Call (30 minutes): A casual conversation to get to know each other and discuss your background and interests.

  2. Technical Interview (45-60 minutes): Dive into technical skills and problem-solving.

  3. Personal Fit Interview (30-45 minutes): Meet one of our founders to explore alignment with our values and vision.

  4. Onsite Case Study (1–2 days): Join us at PastaHR to work on a case study, interact with the team, and experience our culture firsthand.

  5. Decision: We’ll get back to you promptly with our decision and next steps.

We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Infra Platform Group, where you'll play a key role in scaling core infrastructure, empowering product engineering teams, and driving technical strategy.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager of the Infra Platform Group, you will manage two Haskell/Rust teams (Infra Blue and Infra Red) and one Python team (Python Infrastructure and Performance - PIP). The group consists of three team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~12 individual contributors in total.

These teams work on Channable’s core infrastructure, including services such as a data processing engine and a job scheduler. While scaling our applications to handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput with high speed and responsiveness is key, the work goes far beyond performance. You will focus on building new capabilities for product engineering teams, making their lives easier by delivering unified technical solutions across product groups, foreseeing infrastructure challenges, and collaborating directly with product engineering teams and the CTO to align initiatives with company strategy.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the technical roadmap by balancing the work on scaling and performance with feature requests from the product teams

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Maintain a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • Oversee and improve the hiring process for platform engineers

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account

💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • Ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team while managing performance and professional development

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • You are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • You are collaborative, empowering, and adaptable - ready to take on challenges and contribute to strategic decision-making

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Ansible, Terraform, React, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.


Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Note: The official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

jobs.description:
Associate Director, Strategic Program Management

Associate Director, Strategic Program Management, CDx/IVD

Position Overview

Natera is seeking an Associate Director of Strategic Program Management to lead IVD and companion diagnostic (CDx) programs from development planning through PMA submission. This leader will shape the development strategy with functional experts and own the integrated execution plan across assay development, software and bioinformatics, analytical and clinical validation, laboratory operations, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs.

The Associate Director will bring clarity to complex programs, connect decisions across workstreams, and drive teams toward critical development and submission milestones. This is a highly visible role requiring the ability to lead without direct authority, resolve competing priorities, and present clear recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT). The role focuses on internal CDx development and execution; dedicated partnership leaders own external pharmaceutical partner management.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead IVD/CDx program execution

  • Lead complex IVD/CDx programs through development, design transfer, validation, and PMA submission.
  • Build and maintain an integrated program plan covering deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points, and regulatory milestones.
  • Partner with functional leaders to define objectives, development priorities, success criteria, and executable plans.
  • Anticipate risks, identify gaps and trade-offs, and drive timely decisions across functions.
  • Establish clear program governance, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability for commitments.

Drive development and submission readiness

  • Integrate assay development, design controls, software and bioinformatics, analytical validation, clinical validation, laboratory implementation, and submission activities.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality to align program execution with FDA interactions, applicable requirements, and PMA evidence needs.
  • Coordinate plans for assay changes, comparability or bridging studies, and transition to the final CDx configuration, as applicable.
  • Lead reviews at major development gates to confirm deliverables, readiness criteria, open risks, and decisions.
  • Track submission-critical evidence and documentation, and drive resolution of gaps that could affect PMA quality or timing.

Provide executive leadership and communication

  • Present program strategy, progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to the ELT and other senior governance forums.
  • Translate complex scientific, operational, and regulatory issues into concise, data-backed options and decisions.
  • Build alignment among leaders with different priorities and hold teams accountable for agreed actions and milestones.
  • Escalate material issues early, with a clear assessment of their impact and a recommended path forward.
  • Provide the internal program status and decision support needed by colleagues who lead external pharmaceutical partner relationships.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive program or project management experience in molecular diagnostics, in vitro diagnostics, medical devices, biotechnology, or a related regulated field.
  • Direct experience leading CDx or IVD development programs involving design controls, validation planning, and FDA submission preparation.
  • Experience building and driving integrated plans across technical, clinical, regulatory, quality, software, and operations functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior cross-functional stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and deliver results without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience presenting complex programs, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Strong ability to connect technical decisions, resource needs, regulatory evidence, and timelines to the overall program strategy.

Preferred

  • Experience leading a CDx or IVD program through PMA submission or a major PMA milestone.
  • Experience with next generation sequencing, genomic diagnostics, or biomarker-defined patient populations.
  • Experience coordinating analytical and clinical validation strategies and managing changes between clinical trial and final commercial assay configurations.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical development timelines and the dependencies between a therapeutic program and its companion diagnostic.
  • Advanced degree or program management certification.

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will lead the program beyond milestone tracking. They will understand the science and regulatory strategy well enough to ask informed questions, recognize when a decision in one workstream creates risk elsewhere, and bring the right leaders together to resolve it. They will foster trust and open discussion, make ownership clear, and give executives an accurate view of progress and the decisions needed to deliver the program.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. jobs.description:
Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Oncology Algorithms)

Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team in the Oncology R&D organization. You will oversee the planning and execution of development of AI-based diagnostic algorithms, taking them through the development phase, analytical validation and into commercial launch. You will hire and manage the team, support its professional growth, and set the development strategy for new products.

The role calls for extensive experience in algorithm development, NGS data processing across DNA, RNA and methylation, H&E image processing, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product development in a regulated setting. You will implement methods to optimize performance and help define the product profile from a computational perspective, with input from cross-functional teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, hire and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and build a culture of scientific rigor.
  • Development Strategy: Own the development strategy behind new products, from scoping through execution. Work with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.
  • Development To Launch: Lead algorithms through the development phase to CLIA readiness. This includes locking the algorithm and its intended use, supporting analytical validation studies by setting performance targets and acceptance criteria in collaboration with the biostatistics team. You will also support clinical validation and produce the documentation that quality, regulatory, and laboratory directors need to release the test.
  • Model Robustness and Performance: Develop and improve biomarker models and classifiers across modalities. Establish strategies for quality control, generalization across sites, scanners, and sequencing runs, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable, validated production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, and containerization, and reproducibility under change control. Automate the routine parts of research data management, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.
  • Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team, you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from multimodal data including, DNA, RNA and/or methylation sequencing data, digital pathology for clinical diagnostic use.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took an algorithm from research into real clinical use, including a successful CLIA or comparable regulated release, not only to a result.
  • Working knowledge of analytical validation for algorithms, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, limit of detection, and reproducibility.

Preferred:

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience integrating multimodal data (DNA, RNA, histology and other omics data), into a single predictive model or classifier.
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply (CLIA, CAP, design controls, and software validation and change control).
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills, with experience in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (WDL, Nextflow).
  • Containerization (Docker) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

Region Head, Asia

Role Description

As Regional Head of Partner Sales, Asia, you’ll lead a team of Partner Sales Managers and build the distributor and reseller relationships that bring Dropbox solutions to customers across the region.

Based in Singapore, you’ll own the team’s commercial performance across new business, expansion and retention. You’ll set market priorities, shape partner coverage and guide where the team focuses its effort. Alongside delivering results, you’ll coach and develop sales talent, helping the team build the capability and confidence to grow the business.

You’ll work with regional and global leaders to turn your market insight into action and influence Dropbox’s wider partner strategy. This is an opportunity to combine regional commercial ownership with people leadership, making decisions that strengthen customer relationships and build a productive, sustainable partner business.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Asia’s partner sales strategy, translating business goals into market priorities, partner segmentation, team coverage and investment recommendations.

  • Own the team’s performance against new-business, expansion and retention targets, establishing reliable forecasting and taking action to address pipeline risks and performance gaps.

  • Lead, coach and develop the Partner Sales Manager team, setting clear expectations, retaining talent, addressing underperformance fairly and building succession plans for critical responsibilities.

Clinical Research Associate

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior/Clinical Research Associate.

Position Summary:
The Senior/CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management.
Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
• Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
• Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
• Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
• Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
• If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
• Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
• Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
