jobs.title: Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer

Mid-Senior Full-Stack AI Product Engineer

About Oda

Spatial Commerce builds Oda AI, a platform that turns real spaces into ground-truthed world models. Creating the spatial layer that AI and software plug into to understand and act on the built environment.The AI behind it runs in production: a conversational space planner that proposes layouts and waits for approval before applying them, vision pipelines that locate objects in 3D captures, GPU rendering services, and retrieval over scene knowledge.

We recently raised €1.5M from AI & PropTech investors and have licensed technology from a well known German research institute. We’re looking for a full-stack engineer who can multiply what a small team ships. You’ll work with a team of five engineers, the CEO and the CPO on product decisions, and customers.

What you’ll own

  • Planner and assistant. Improve how the in-viewer planner interprets requests, proposes options and checks collisions before a change is approved. Decide which requests need a model and which need a deterministic query.

  • Vision and GPU pipelines. Run and improve the services that render captures, segment objects and match catalogue items to scanned spaces. These run on Cloud and making them scale is an open problem.

  • Evaluation. Build and maintain the evals that decide whether a model or prompt change is safe to ship, and extend CI coverage beyond today’s agent tool-call checks.

  • Scaling and cost. Keep latency and per-document cost under control as usage grows, across LLM calls, GPU jobs, and the graph and vector stores behind them.

  • Architecture calls. Choose tools, frameworks and code structure, and own the reasoning. Some of the open questions are model routing per scene and where the Graph DB read model should stop being rebuildable.

  • Product sense. Turn a vague customer need into a shipped feature, and say when the answer is not an AI feature at all.

  • AI-Assisted Operations: Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them.

Our stack

Cloud: Google Cloud Platform. Production and staging are separate GCP projects, with services in a European region.

Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Turborepo monorepo, PlayCanvas and three.js for 3D, next-intl across 15 locales.

AI: Genkit with Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers, routing across model providers, embedding-based retrieval, VLM and Foundation Models.

Backend: Firebase on GCP (Firestore, Storage, Auth, App Hosting, App Check), Firebase Functions, Neo4j as a rebuildable graph and vector read Docker.

Compute: Python services on Cloud Run, Cloud Run Jobs triggered per document, gsplat and PyTorch/CUDA, Blender scripting for room authoring.

Delivery: GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Secret Manager, Playwright and Jest, load tests against staging and production, PostHog for product analytics.

What you bring

Required

  • Years of Experience: Six or more years building production software, including at least two years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Core Technical Skills: Strong TypeScript and React, and comfort in Python for model-serving or data work.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar.

  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Github, GitHub Actions, or similar.

  • Cloud: Hands on experience with Google Cloud, Firebase or a similar managed stack.

  • Experience running GPU or other compute-heavy workloads in production, including queueing, retries, timeouts and cost control.

  • You have architected or helped build out an early-stage product until hundreds of thousands of people used it daily. You can name the decisions that got it there and the ones you’d make differently.

  • A habit of writing evals or measurable acceptance checks before trusting a model change.

  • You have made hard calls on tools and code and can defend them: what to keep, what to delete, and when a simpler approach beats a clever one.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with LLM agents that use tools, structured outputs or retrieval over domain data.

  • Graph databases (Neo4j or similar) and vector indexes at scale.

  • Experience with Firestore security rules and server-side authorization, where admin credentials bypass client rules.

  • Real product ownership: you have talked to users, made tradeoffs in a spec, and shipped something you then had to maintain.

Nice to have

  • Experience with 3D data: sfM, Pointcloud, 3D Gaussian Splatting.

  • Blender Python, PlayCanvas or three.js in a production app.

How you’ll work

  • We ship constantly and keep a short constitution that every change must respect. You’ll read it on day one and help improve it. It favours simple code, surgical changes and verifiable success criteria.

  • You write the spec, the test and the rollout plan, not only the code.

  • You own the on-call for your features and the metrics that show they work.

  • You decide when a problem needs a model and when it needs a database query, and you can explain that decision to a customer.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our Berlin - Alexanderplatz or Berlin - Charlottenburg office. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on-site a minimum of 3 days per week.

Webentwickler für interne Tools & Automatisierung (m/w/d)

Du entwickelst unsere interne Software weiter, baust Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools und automatisierst Abläufe mit n8n und KI. Dafür bringst du praktische Programmiererfahrung mit. Ein bis zwei Jahre technische Praxis reichen für den Einstieg aus, wenn du bestehenden Code lesen, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler eingrenzen kannst.

Wir sind AdKochMarketing, eine Recruiting- und Employer-Branding-Agentur für das Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen. Von unserem Hamburger Büro aus betreuen wir Kunden in der DACH-Region und haben bereits über 250 Projekte umgesetzt. Deine Anwendungen und Automationen nutzt unser Team täglich im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Interne Software weiterentwickeln. Du arbeitest dich in unsere bestehenden Anwendungen ein, setzt Änderungen im Code um und baust neue Frontends und Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools.

  • Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren. Du schaust dir an, welche Arbeitsschritte sich im Team wiederholen, und entwickelst dafür zuverlässige Workflows mit n8n, Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • KI-Agenten und Prompts entwickeln. Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows, testest ihre Ergebnisse anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle und verbesserst sie für den täglichen Einsatz.

  • Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse aufbauen. Du verbindest CRM, externe Datenquellen und weitere SaaS-Tools über APIs. Du entwickelst Workflows, die Daten erfassen, anreichern und ans CRM übergeben.

  • Datenbanken und Infrastruktur betreuen. Du pflegst Datenstrukturen in Supabase und Airtable und betreust unsere Anwendungen auf UpCloud.

  • Fehler beheben und technische Abläufe dokumentieren. Du findest heraus, warum ein Workflow oder eine Anwendung ausfällt, behebst die Ursache und hältst die wichtigsten Abläufe so fest, dass das Team sie nachvollziehen kann.

  • Technische Lösungen fürs Team umsetzen. Du klärst Anforderungen mit den Kollegen, führst bei Bedarf neue Tools ein und hilfst bei technischen Fragen zu unseren internen Systemen.

Das bringst du mit

  • 1-2 Jahre technisches Grundverständnis und praktische Programmiererfahrung. Du kannst dich in vorhandenen Code einarbeiten, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler systematisch eingrenzen. JavaScript oder TypeScript passen besonders gut zu unserem Stack. Andere Programmiersprachen wie Python sind ebenfalls eine gute Grundlage.

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in einem IT-Bereich, z.B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Fachinformatik, Elektrotechnik bzw. andere nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich IT / Automatisierung

  • Interesse an Frontends und Low-Code. Du möchtest interne Benutzeroberflächen entwickeln und arbeitest dich selbstständig in die dafür nötigen Tools ein.

  • Struktur- und Prozessdenken. Du verstehst, wie Abläufe zusammenhängen, arbeitest dich in bestehende Prozesse ein und entwickelst Lösungen, die sich im Alltag zuverlässig nutzen und pflegen lassen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Du kannst Anforderungen mit dem Team klären und technische Abläufe verständlich dokumentieren.

Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, mit Next.js oder Low-Code-Frontends sowie mit APIs, Supabase, Airtable oder SQL. Auch Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Gemini und mit CRM-Anbindungen ist willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • 💸 4.000–5.000 € brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung.

  • 🏡 Vor Ort oder hybrid. Du kannst vollständig in unserem Hamburger Büro arbeiten oder hybrid mit 3 Tagen vor Ort und 2 Tagen im Homeoffice pro Woche. Unser Büro liegt in der Spaldingstraße 218 20097 Hamburg, 3. OG.

  • ⚙️ Eigene technische Projekte. Du begleitest interne Anwendungen und Automationen von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz. Bei der Umsetzung bringst du deine eigenen Ideen ein.

  • 🚀 Ergebnisse, die du im Alltag siehst. Das Team nutzt deine Lösungen im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting. Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, welche Arbeitsschritte deine Lösungen vereinfachen.

  • 💻 Ein vielseitiger Tech-Stack. Du arbeitest mit n8n, Make, Supabase, Airtable und UpCloud. Dazu kommen API-Integrationen und KI-Tools wie GPT und Claude.

  • 🧠 Fachliche Entwicklung im Job. Du vertiefst deine Programmierkenntnisse, baust interne Oberflächen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Agenten, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen.

  • 📈 Perspektive auf mehr Verantwortung. Mit wachsender Erfahrung kannst du größere Projekte eigenständig übernehmen und mitentscheiden, wie sich unsere interne Software weiterentwickelt.

  • 🤝 Kurze Abstimmungswege im Team. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Recruiting, Marketing und Kundenbetreuung zusammen und kannst Anforderungen und Feedback schnell klären.

Du hast schon einmal eine Anwendung gebaut, eine Schnittstelle angebunden oder einen Prozess automatisiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Erzähl uns gern kurz von einem Projekt und davon, was du dabei selbst umgesetzt hast.

jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Android Engineer
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The team

We're on a mission to take our mobile app to the next level, and we're looking for someone to help shape the future of our Android experience in Kotlin. You'll join one of our mobile engineering teams, working across the technical foundations that power the app and the customer experiences built on top of them: architecture, shared libraries, core experiences, build systems, analytics, and the features our customers use every day.

Depending on where your experience and our needs best align, you could focus more on shared foundations (app architecture, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD), or more on owning and evolving customer journeys end to end. Wherever you land, you'll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, raise the bar on quality and developer experience, and work closely with product, design and engineering partners to deliver an app that is reliable, scalable and a pleasure to use.

Our app is built natively in Swift and Kotlin, and we're continuing to invest in strong native foundations and a best-in-class Android experience. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of that journey!


A day in the life:
  • You will report to the Engineering Manager for the Zopa mobile team.
  • You will work closely with other native mobile engineers to design, build, and evolve our Android app.
  • You will play a key role in evolving our native Android app, building in Kotlin with strong architectural foundations and industry best practices.
  • You will collaborate with the wider mobile engineering community to define best practices for native development and mentor engineers as they grow their native Android skills.
  • You will improve the performance, robustness, and overall quality of the app by identifying bottlenecks, addressing technical debt, and fixing defects to optimise the user experience.
  • You will collaborate with cross-functional partners – including product managers, designers, and backend engineers to design and deliver features that fully leverage native Android capabilities.

    • About you:
  • You are an experienced mobile app developer with a strong track record of building and shipping production Android applications in Kotlin, including publishing apps to the Google Play Store.
  • You have a solid understanding of Android frameworks, platform APIs, and native app development best practices.
  • You have worked on modern, high-engagement mobile applications, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and delivering delightful user experiences.
  • You treat quality as a first-class concern and have a proven history of raising engineering standards through thoughtful design, testing, and maintainable code. You take pride in your craft and in doing things right.
  • You are motivated by opportunities to have broad impact, introducing better processes, tooling, and automation to raise the bar for mobile engineering across teams.
  • You have a strong customer focus and a genuine interest in Zopa's mission.

    • Added bonus (but not essential):
  • Experience applying mobile security best practices in production Android applications.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps, including build, test, and release automation.
  • Experience collaborating closely with iOS (Swift) and/or React Native engineers in a cross-platform mobile environment.
    • #LI-IB1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

     

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

     

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Product Owner

Pet Drugs Online Role  

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

Pet Drugs Online is one of the UK’s leading online pet pharmacies and retailers, helping pet owners access trusted medication, healthcare products, and everyday essentials quickly, safely, and conveniently. As part of the IVC Evidensia Group, Pet Drugs Online combines the agility of a growing ecommerce business with the strength and expertise of a leading veterinary care organisation. 

Our teams play a vital role in making pet healthcare more accessible through innovation, operational excellence, and outstanding customer experience.


Help shape the future of eCommerce at Pet Drugs Online.

This is an exciting opportunity to join our eCommerce team at a time when there's plenty of opportunity to make a real impact. From improving website functionality and customer journeys to introducing new technologies and enhancing internal processes, there's no shortage of interesting projects to get involved in.

Working closely with our Lead Product Owner, you'll play a key role in turning business ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements, bridging the gap between commercial stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

The Role

This is a varied, hands-on position combining Product Ownership and Business Analysis responsibilities. You'll take ownership of initiatives from initial discovery and requirements gathering through to development, testing and launch.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across eCommerce, Marketing, Commercial, Customer Service and Operations, as well as our external development agency and internal technology teams.

Some of the key areas you'll be involved in include:

  • Product Development: Help shape and deliver improvements across the Pet Drugs Online website, identifying opportunities to enhance functionality and customer experience.
  • Discovery & Requirements: Work with stakeholders to understand business challenges, explore opportunities and translate ideas into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Backlog Management: Create and maintain product backlogs, write user stories and acceptance criteria, and support prioritisation of development activities.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships across the business, facilitating discussions, challenging existing processes and ensuring everyone understands the objectives and proposed solutions.
  • Agile Delivery: Work closely with developers, QA and our external development agency, supporting sprint activities, clarifying requirements and resolving queries throughout development.
  • Testing & Launch: Support user acceptance testing, validate delivered functionality and ensure new features and improvements are ready for release.
  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor performance, gather feedback and identify further opportunities to improve both customer-facing experiences and internal business processes.

What makes this opportunity interesting?

Pet Drugs Online is already a successful eCommerce business, but there is significant opportunity to take its digital offering to the next level.

You'll be joining at a particularly interesting time, with several important initiatives and improvements across the website and wider customer journey.

Some of the areas you'll have exposure to include:

  • Enhancing the online prescription journey, making it easier and more straightforward for customers to purchase medication for their pets.
  • Improving website search, product discovery and merchandising through new technologies.
  • Developing and improving subscription journeys.
  • Enhancing key website experiences, including the basket, checkout and customer account areas.
  • Exploring new ways to improve customer experience, website functionality and operational efficiency.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a broad range of initiatives, from smaller improvements and fixes through to larger, more strategic projects.

About You

We're looking for someone who understands digital products and eCommerce, enjoys solving problems and can confidently bring different stakeholders together to deliver meaningful improvements.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Digital Product or eCommerce role.
  • Experience working on digital or eCommerce platforms, with an understanding of website functionality and customer journeys.
  • A track record of contributing to digital improvements or projects, ideally with examples such as website enhancements, checkout improvements, conversion rate optimisation or platform changes.
  • Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes and translating business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and experience working alongside development teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and insight to inform decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Just as important is your approach.

You'll be a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership, working independently and making recommendations. You'll be confident challenging existing ways of working, facilitating discussions and explaining the reasoning behind your decisions.

You don't need to be particularly technical or have experience with a specific platform. What's important is that you understand how digital products are developed and can effectively bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery.

The Details

  • Salary: £50,000–£58,000
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid
  • Office Attendance: Two-Three days per week in our Keynsham office

Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging 

At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are keen to hear from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions and would be happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments needed during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Credit Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
Credit Strategy Analyst

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Credit Strategy Analyst (Hybrid in London)

You'll support & refine our lending strategy, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk.

Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses with the funds they need to grow.

The team

The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca's growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London.

 

The role

We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Credit Strategy Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca's lending strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build expertise in the credit domain.

  • Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis.

  • Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions.

  • Partner with key stakeholders in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes).

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards, presenting a clear picture of the state of our lending.

  • Practice turning data into information, and information into insights, so that you and various stakeholders can deliver improvements with real impact for our customers.

The requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • A degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar.

  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to support decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor analysis and recommendations to different audiences.

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving.

  • A bucket-load of common sense.

  • A commitment to using modern tools effectively – including AI – to maximise quality, speed, and rigour, while retaining responsibility for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • Experience in B2B or B2C credit risk lending and strategy.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Looker

The salary

We expect to pay from £40,000–£65,000 for this role, dependent on your experience. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

jobs.title: Clinical Training and Education Lead
jobs.description:
Clinical Training and Education Lead

What is the job?

This is an opportunity to shape how our clinical teams learn, develop and perform as Montu continues to grow.

Sitting within the Learning and Development function, you will take ownership of the learning experience across our clinical teams. You will build structured, engaging and practical development programmes that give our people the knowledge, skills and confidence to deliver safe, consistent and patient-centred care.

You do not need to be a clinician or hold a professional healthcare registration. However, you will need to understand the realities of working in a clinical environment, including the importance of patient safety, clinical governance, regulatory compliance and quality.

Working closely with clinical subject-matter experts, operational leaders and the wider People team, you will turn complex standards, processes and clinical requirements into learning that people can understand, apply and embed in their everyday work.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is passionate about developing people, confident working with specialist stakeholders and comfortable building learning solutions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What You Will Own

Clinical Learning and Development

  • Own the learning and development plan for our clinical teams, ensuring it supports business priorities, service growth and workforce capability

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding, induction and ongoing development programmes for new and existing team members

  • Build clear learning pathways that support employees from joining the business through to continued development and career progression

  • Create engaging workshops, digital learning, practical resources and supporting materials for a range of clinical audiences

  • Conduct training needs analyses, skills audits and capability assessments to identify current and future development priorities

  • Deliver group workshops, virtual learning sessions and one-to-one coaching where required

  • Support the delivery and monitoring of mandatory training and continuing professional development requirements

Competency and Capability

  • Develop clear and practical competency frameworks in partnership with clinical subject-matter experts

  • Create consistent approaches to assessing knowledge, skills and competence across clinical teams

  • Work with managers to identify capability gaps and put appropriate development plans in place

  • Support leaders in embedding coaching, feedback and reflective practice within their teams

  • Ensure learning is transferred into day-to-day performance rather than ending when the training session finishes

Clinical Standards and Governance

  • Work closely with Clinical Governance, Quality, Safeguarding and operational leaders to ensure learning reflects current standards and requirements

  • Translate clinical policies, pathways, Standard Operating Procedures and regulatory requirements into clear and practical learning

  • Support the rollout of new clinical services, systems, technologies and ways of working through effective training and change support

  • Ensure relevant learning supports Care Quality Commission standards, patient safety requirements and internal governance expectations

  • Recognise where specialist clinical input or approval is required and work with the appropriate subject-matter expert

  • Maintain accurate learning, competency and compliance records across clinical teams

Learning Impact and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish clear measures of success for learning programmes and evaluate their impact on capability, performance and service quality

  • Use assessment outcomes, employee feedback, audit findings, quality data, incidents, complaints and patient feedback to identify learning priorities

  • Produce meaningful learning insights and reports to demonstrate progress, risks and areas for improvement

  • Regularly review and improve learning content to ensure it remains accurate, relevant and effective

  • Identify opportunities to improve how learning is delivered, recorded and embedded across the business

  • Champion a culture where learning, coaching, feedback and continuous improvement are part of everyday work

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build credible and trusted relationships with clinical, operational and People leaders

  • Partner with subject-matter experts to create learning that is clinically accurate, engaging and appropriate for its audience

  • Coach and support managers to identify development needs and build capability within their teams

  • Balance learning priorities with operational requirements in a busy and fast-moving environment

  • Act as the Learning and Development lead for relevant clinical change and transformation projects

What do you need?

  • Strong experience within Learning and Development, workforce development, operational training or a similar role

  • A good understanding of clinical or healthcare environments, including patient safety, clinical governance, quality and regulatory requirements

  • Experience designing and delivering engaging learning programmes for specialist, operational or regulated teams

  • Strong learning design skills, with the ability to turn complex or technical information into clear and practical learning

  • Experience developing structured onboarding programmes, learning pathways or competency frameworks

  • Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills

  • The confidence to work with clinical specialists and senior stakeholders without needing to be the clinical expert in the room

  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different teams

  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business

  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work through to completion

  • Experience using data, feedback and performance measures to evaluate learning and drive improvement

  • Experience supporting organisational change, service transformation or the implementation of new systems and processes

  • Confidence using learning management systems, digital learning tools and reporting platforms

  • A relevant Learning and Development, education or training qualification would be beneficial but is not essential

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and free up time for medical teams. Following our $20M Series A, we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York, and 250 healthcare organizations use Vocca.

Eliott (CEO) and Hugo (CTO) have more topics to open than time to work on them: the US launch, new verticals, new countries, a finance function to structure. Maxime, our Chief of Staff, turns their priorities into projects, and his own scope is growing fast.

We are opening a Founder Associate internship to give them leverage. You report to Maxime and work on the founders' priorities, in daily contact with the three of them. The role is open to business and engineering profiles.

Your mission

Take on the topics Eliott and Hugo cannot dig into themselves and bring each one to a result they can use: a quantified recommendation they can decide on, a model or a process the team works with, or an experiment with measured results.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You know the product, our customers and how each team works, in France and in the US

  • You have delivered a first project from start to finish, scoped with Maxime

After 3 months:

  • The US sales team works from a target account list you built from our usage data, with the enablement material that goes with it

  • You have presented a first quantified market study to the founders (a new vertical or a new country): sizing, segmentation and a go or no-go recommendation

  • The Chief of Staff team uses a financial model you built, on unit economics or on an expansion scenario

After 6 months:

  • You run two or three recurring topics on your own

  • You have designed and run at least one growth experiment, from hypothesis to a statistical reading of the results, with a recommendation to scale or stop

  • At least one of your recommendations has become a company decision

What you will work on

You cannot list everything a Founder Associate does. This is what your day-to-day looks like.

Market exploration

  • Run quantified studies on new verticals and new countries: market sizing, segmentation, go-to-market modeling

  • Run product and competitive benchmarks

  • Bring structured recommendations back to the founders

Growth and US sales enablement

  • Design growth experiments and measure them: hypotheses, metrics, statistical reading of the results

  • Build target account and call lists for the US team from our usage data

  • Produce the enablement material the sales team needs

Finance structuring

  • Build financial models with Maxime: unit economics, expansion scenarios, sensitivity to pricing assumptions

  • Build the reports used to steer the company

  • Run the analyses the founders need to make a decision

Public affairs

  • Follow the regulation of AI in healthcare and the public debate around it, and flag what affects us

  • Map the public bodies, health authorities and professional organizations that matter for Vocca, in France and in the US

  • Prepare the founders' meetings with them: briefs, position notes, follow-ups

Founder branding

  • Make Eliott and Hugo known and listened to in two communities: the healthcare professionals who buy Vocca, and the talent we want to hire

  • Run their content with them: LinkedIn posts, talks, events

  • Track what works with each audience and adjust

Ops playbook, depending on your profile

Depending on what you thrive in, business, engineering or something else, you can also take ownership of pieces of our Ops playbook: the process by which we deploy a voice agent in a new clinic, from configuration to go-live.

  • Map each step and instrument it with the right data

  • Find where time and quality are lost

  • Redesign the process so it scales from hundreds to thousands of sites without growing the team at the same rate

Beyond this list

Depending on what you are good at and what you want to learn, you will pick up other topics: recruiting, internal operations, internal communication.

This role is for you if

Requirements:

  • You are in your final year at a top-tier engineering or business school and looking for a 6-month end-of-studies internship starting in January 2027

  • You have already built something: you ran a student society, launched a project, or worked in a demanding environment such as a startup, a bank or a consulting firm

  • You are fluent in French and English

What we will assess:

  • You understand fast, and you can turn a vague question into a structured answer with a recommendation

  • You have strong business sense. You will work with the founders and Maxime every day

  • You are at ease with numbers and data: you can build a model, size a market and read the results of an experiment

  • You are very autonomous and organized. You manage up: you say what you need, raise blockers early and follow up without being asked

  • You are entrepreneurial. You know the startup world, you love tech, and you want to start a company one day

  • You are AI literate and understand how an AI product works

  • You break silos: you move easily between teams in Paris and New York

  • You keep asking how you could do better and have more impact

Nice to have: programming notions, which help on the Ops playbook.

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want a fixed scope. Your topics will change with the company's priorities

  • You only want to work on strategy. A good part of the job is execution: building models and lists, running experiments, keeping a report up to date

  • You need close supervision to move forward

After the internship

We built this internship as a way into Vocca. If it goes well, we want you to stay full time, in a role we define together based on what you did best.

Compensation and benefits

  • €2,000 gross per month

  • 6-month end-of-studies internship (convention de stage), starting January 2027

  • Based at our Paris office (2nd arrondissement), with possible trips to our New York office paid by the company

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers and 50% of your Navigo pass covered

  • Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Video call with our Talent Acquisition team (30 min)

  2. Video interview with Maxime, Chief of Staff (30 min)

  3. On-site business case with Maxime (1h)

  4. On-site meeting with Eliott, CEO, and/or Hugo, CTO, followed by a coffee with the team (1h)

  5. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

Product Engineer (TypeScript)

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • More than 1,000 medical staff use our product all day

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

What you will own

  • The scenario engine and its configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp.

  • The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Internal tooling already took a clinic deployment from days to under an hour. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding.

  • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and follow a design system written in code.

  • Your features, end to end. From the spec with the ops team to production, and the fix when something breaks, with the reason it does not happen again.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 3 to 8 years building full-stack products in production, in startups that were growing fast.

  • You stayed long enough somewhere to see a system live, break and get better, and you learned from it.

  • TypeScript is your main language, backend and frontend, not a line on your CV. You have a real eye for interface quality and the discipline to follow a design system.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code, and you know how to build systems that hold when the volume explodes.

  • You move without waiting for a perfect frame: you try, you propose, you ship. You ask for help when you are stuck.

  • You had good practices before AI: solid system design, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

Probably not for you if you need every feature fully specified before you start

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first improvement on the dashboard is in production.

  • First month. You own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production, without mockups or hand-holding.

  • First 3 months. The first version of the scenario engine is in production. A standard clinic can be onboarded without a developer ticket.

  • 6 to 12 months. Most new clinics are live within 7 days. Clinics configure their own rules in the dashboard.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about product architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

Rattaché·e à la responsable communication, tu deviens son bras droit au sein du pôle communication. Tu prends en main trois chantiers : l'événementiel, les relations presse et la communication interne.

Au-delà de ces missions, tu es son relais au quotidien : tu la secondes dans le pilotage des projets comm, tu assures la continuité en son absence.

  1. Communication interne

  1. Bras droit de la responsable communication

jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description:
Head of Design
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As Head of Design, you will shape how people understand, direct and work with autonomous robots in some of the world’s most demanding industrial environments.

This is not a conventional software design leadership role. Our products combine mobile robotics, operator interfaces, autonomous behaviour, inspection workflows and complex 3D data to support the people who plan, perform and act on industrial inspections. There are still few established design patterns for bringing these elements together into one intuitive, trusted experience. You will help create them.

Today, our design capability spans UX/UI, product design, industrial design and future concept development across several teams. You will bring these disciplines together, establish a coherent design direction across the full product ecosystem and remain hands-on in solving the hardest design challenges.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Advanced Technology and our customer-facing teams. You will also spend time with customers and users in the industrial environments where our robots operate, ensuring that the experiences we pioneer solve real problems for the people who rely on them.


Your Impact

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary design team, setting clear goals, raising the quality bar and creating the conditions for strong designers to do their best work.

  • Build understanding of the value of design across the organisation and strengthen the partnership between Product, Design and Engineering.

  • Define a unified design vision across the physical robot, digital products, spatial interfaces and the end-to-end customer experience.

  • Establish shared design principles, processes and ways of working from early discovery and concept development through to detailed delivery and validation.

  • Lead discovery and delivery for priority roadmap initiatives, particularly where users interact with robots, autonomous behaviour, 3D environments and spatial information.

  • Build a deeper understanding of our users through field research, personas, end-to-end journeys, validation and a shared customer-knowledge base.

  • Make AI practical within the design organisation, improving how the team explores ideas, prototypes, validates decisions and delivers products.


    • Your Profile

  • You have led and developed designers, including setting goals, giving feedback, coaching performance and making clear decisions when consensus is not enough.

  • You have strong hands-on design experience across complex physical and digital products and can credibly lead across UX/UI, product design, industrial design and human-machine interaction.

  • You have designed products involving 3D or spatial interaction, such as robotics, simulation, digital twins, reality capture, spatial computing or other systems where users interact with a three-dimensional environment.

  • You understand complex B2B products with multiple user and stakeholder groups and can turn customer research into clear product and design priorities.

  • You have built or materially improved a design practice, introducing the right level of structure while remaining pragmatic, hands-on and comfortable operating in ambiguity.

    • This role can be based in Zurich or Barcelona. Regular travel to Zurich and to industrial customer sites will be required, particularly during the first six months, because direct exposure to our robots, teams and users is essential to succeeding in the role.




    Bonus Points

  • Experience designing robotics, autonomous systems, industrial technology, digital twins, reality-capture or architecture and construction products.

  • Experience in game UX, XR, simulation or another field involving intuitive navigation of dynamic 3D environments.

  • Experience conducting research with operators or professionals working in industrial, field-based or safety-critical settings.

  • Experience growing a small design function and hiring complementary design disciplines.

  • Experience using AI to transform design workflows or designing AI-enabled and embodied-AI product experiences.

    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

As a Product Manager (ISR & Strike) at Harmattan AI, you will be at the heart of company strategy, driving the end-to-end definition, development, and delivery of our autonomous persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) and strike systems. You will own the evolution of our existing offer into a next-generation drone carrier platform integrated with proprietary Harmattan AI payloads. Working closely with R&D, you will translate operational needs into technical specifications, manage product configurations and versions, and ensure seamless execution from initial architecture to field deployment.

Senior Data Engineer

Everfield: Senior Data Engineer

The Company

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.

Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.

Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

  • Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

  • Further developing Lakehouse Lumen, our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

  • Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

  • Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

  • Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

  • Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

  • Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

  • Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

  • Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer, and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

  • Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

  • Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

  • Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

  • Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization.

  • Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps.

Soft Skills

  • Independent Worker: Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.

  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Collaborative: Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.

  • Quality-Focused: Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.

  • Strategic Planner: Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.

  • Purpose-Driven: Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

What’s in it for you?

  • Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization.

  • Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.

  • Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.

  • Long term career opportunities.

  • Working from home for up to 4 days per week.

  • Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany).

jobs.title: Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy
jobs.description:
Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy

0.8 – 1 fte week | Utrecht | Hybride | Hbo/wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy. Ben jij een expert op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en privacy en combineer je inhoudelijke kennis met een pragmatische aanpak? En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties.

  • Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering.

  • Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s.

  • Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

  • Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

  • Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

  • De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je korte lijnen hebt met collega’s en de ruimte krijgt om verbeteringen voor te stellen en op te pakken.


Dit neem je mee

Je hebt een stevige basis in informatiebeveiliging en privacy en vindt het leuk om zaken daadwerkelijk voor elkaar te krijgen. Je kunt beleid en risico’s vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Tegelijkertijd heb je de ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn ook meer strategische verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarbij neem je mee:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau; bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van securitymanagement, bestuurskunde of bedrijfskunde.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring en relevante ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en/of privacy.

Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

In deze functie krijg je ruimte om samen met collega’s de het information- & securitybeleid verder vorm te geven en je inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Zo bouw je mee aan de informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot én aan je eigen volgende stap.

Solliciteer meteen

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Senior Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

You’ll be UpGuard’s first marketer in EMEA, making sure the region gets what it needs to grow. That means two things. First, you’ll deliver partner marketing across EMEA, running programs and events with our channel and technology partners that create pipeline. Second, you’ll be the main marketing contact for the region, working with EMEA sales leaders every week and with our global marketing team to make sure events, campaigns, content, and collateral land well in local markets.

You won’t be expected to do everything yourself. Global teams own demand generation, product marketing, content, and brand. Your job is to bring the region’s needs to them, adapt what they build for EMEA, and run the activity that only someone on the ground can, especially partner events. You’ll work from a regional plan and budget. This is a hands-on role, and success is measured by the pipeline you help create.

What will you do?

  • Be the main marketing contact for EMEA, with a standing weekly check-in with regional sales leaders

  • Deliver the EMEA partner marketing plan agreed with your manager and our channel team, running joint campaigns, webinars, and enablement content with the resellers, MSPs, and technology partners most likely to produce pipeline.

  • Manage and organise EMEA partner events end to end, including co-hosted roundtables and executive dinners, sponsored partner conferences, and partner enablement sessions. That covers venue and vendor sourcing, logistics, joint promotion, on-site delivery, and making sure leads are shared and followed up with partners and sales.

  • Work with sales and demand gen on account-based programs and regional campaigns, coordinating events, outreach, and content around target accounts and contributing to regional lead generation.

  • Build UpGuard’s presence in the region through EMEA customer stories, references, and speakers, regional PR and media, and relationships with industry associations and CISO communities (e.g. ISACA and ISC2 chapters).

  • Localize global campaigns, content, and collateral for EMEA markets and languages, and feed regional regulatory developments (e.g. NIS2, DORA, GDPR) to product marketing so our messaging stays relevant.

  • Track market development funds and co-marketing spend for partner events and campaigns, and partner-sourced and influenced pipeline in the CRM, within agreed budgets.

  • Report on regional and partner performance against agreed goals, and share insights and recommendations to inform future plans.

What will you bring?

  • 6+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant time in partner/channel marketing, field marketing, or regional marketing in EMEA.

  • Experience selling to security, IT, risk, or compliance buyers, ideally in cybersecurity.

  • A track record of partner or regional programs that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Experience running account-based programs with sales, and building customer advocacy or regional PR.

  • Comfort working as a team of one in-region while collaborating closely with a global team across time zones.

  • Strong relationships with sales leaders and an instinct for turning field feedback into marketing action.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or HubSpot and of partner and event attribution.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA.

What will give you an edge?

  • Knowledge of EMEA's security regulatory landscape, existing relationships with major regional distributors, MSPs, media, or CISO communities

  • Fluency in a second European language

What’s in it for you?

At UpGuard, we’re passionate about our work, but we’re also passionate about employee wellness and personal growth. We offer a competitive benefits package to help maximize the well-being of all UpGuardians. This includes:

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: use this for financial, physical and mental wellbeing (all regions)

  • WFH set-up allowance: to ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set-up within your first 3 months at UpGuard (all regions)

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: to support your career development all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance (all regions)

  • Generous Annual Leave/PTO allowances: time to recharge your batteries (all regions)

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work (all regions)

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
Security Engineer, Offensive Security

Role Description

As an Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Team’s tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Workday Financials ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations.   • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Workday, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.
