jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst (Europe)
jobs.description:
Revenue Operations Analyst (Europe)

Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Note: this role is based remotely out of Europe.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in Europe with strong overlap to customer business hours in the region.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Senior Software Architect – Computer Vision & Tracking

 

Shape the technology behind some of the biggest moments in world sport.

From goal-line technology and semi-automated offside in football to electronic line calling in tennis and automated ball-strike systems in baseball, Hawk-Eye's tracking technology plays a critical role in elite sport around the world.

 

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Architect to shape the future of this technology.

This is a unique opportunity to combine software architecture leadership with deep computer vision expertise, influencing the technical direction of products used across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby.

 

Working across our Tracking and Automated Officiating (T&AO) value stream, you'll influence an engineering organisation of more than 100 people, setting architectural direction, driving innovation and helping solve some of the most complex tracking challenges in sport.

 

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You'll have significant technical influence while remaining close to the engineering, research and problem-solving that make our technology possible.

 

What you'll do

 

Set the architectural direction

  • Lead software architecture across our tracking, automated officiating and data delivery products.

  • Define how new tracking challenges are approached and ensure consistency across products and sports.

  • Shape our shared frameworks, libraries and core technology, making pragmatic decisions about reuse, scalability and performance.

  • Represent Tracking within engineering architecture forums across Hawk-Eye and Sony Sports.

 

Drive computer vision innovation

  • Act as the senior technical authority for computer vision across Hawk-Eye's tracking technology.

  • Set the direction for camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking and machine learning integration.

  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies, building prototypes to turn promising ideas into practical solutions.

  • Help resolve the most complex technical challenges and ensure our technology continues to evolve.

 

Champion modern engineering

  • Lead the adoption of AI-powered development tools, including agentic coding frameworks, LLM orchestration and automated code generation.

  • Establish practical standards for using these technologies within our large C++ and Python codebases.

  • Explore opportunities in generative AI and synthetic data to accelerate research and improve tracking capabilities.

 

Develop engineering capability

  • Coach and mentor Squad Tech Leads and emerging architects.

  • Share expertise through technical talks, tutorials and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Support recruitment and technical assessment for computer vision and machine learning roles.

  • Help ensure our ML training and synthetic data infrastructure is operationally sustainable.

 

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with exceptional expertise in multi-camera computer vision, combined with the software engineering and architectural experience to influence technology at scale.

 

Computer vision expertise

  • Deep knowledge of multi-camera calibration, including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment.

  • Strong understanding of triangulation, 3D ball tracking, pose estimation and skeletal tracking.

  • Experience with continuous-time modelling and inverse kinematics.

 

Software engineering and architecture

  • Expert cross-platform C++ development across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM.

  • Strong experience with CMake, performance profiling and optimisation.

  • Proven ability to architect complex, high-performance systems across multiple teams and products.

 

Machine learning and infrastructure

  • Experience with GPU inference technologies such as TensorRT and Triton.

  • Strong knowledge of ML frameworks and pipelines, including PyTorch and ONNX.

  • Experience deploying tracking systems across AWS, on-premise infrastructure and edge devices.

  • Understanding of generative AI and synthetic data generation.

 

Modern engineering practices

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and LLM orchestration.

  • An interest in applying emerging AI technologies to accelerate algorithm research, development and refactoring.

 

The person we're looking for

You'll be a confident technical leader who can influence decisions across multiple engineering teams, communicate complex ideas clearly and make pragmatic architectural choices.

You'll be comfortable working with senior stakeholders and external technology partners, including Sony, NVIDIA and AWS, as well as sports leagues and federations.

Just as importantly, you'll know when to challenge existing approaches, balance technical ambition with commercial realities and make clear recommendations on priorities, risks and investment.

 

Why join Hawk-Eye?

Our technology is trusted across some of the world's biggest sporting competitions. You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Shape the architecture behind internationally deployed sports technology.

  • Influence the technical direction of more than 100 engineers.

  • Work on fascinating challenges across computer vision, 3D tracking, machine learning and real-time processing.

  • Explore and introduce emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools.

  • Collaborate with world-leading technology partners and sporting organisations.

  • Remain hands-on while operating at the highest level of technical influence.

 

If you're passionate about computer vision, thrive on complex engineering challenges and want to help shape the future of technology in sport, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design (AI Experience)
jobs.description:
Director, Product Design (AI Experience)

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a design leader to own the experience of AlphaSense’s most important frontier: the AI-native, agentic product our customers use to build on proprietary financial data.

AlphaSense is shifting from a research library into an end-to-end workflow platform: a "super analyst" with agentic, computer-use capabilities that lets analysts go from question to discovery to synthesis to finished work product (dashboards, decks, models, generated outputs) without leaving the platform. It’s an enormous opportunity, and today the experience is fragmented: years of incremental features, two search paradigms that don’t yet converge, no self-service onboarding, and a wide spectrum of AI fluency across our users.

You will own the design vision for the AI experience and lead a small team to ship it. You’ll set a clear point of view on where the UX is going, collaborate with Product and Engineering while constructively challenging decisions to raise the bar, and turn an ambiguous, cross-team problem space into a coherent, high-quality, trustworthy product.

This is a player-coach role: like all of our directors, you’ll lead a small team of senior designers while staying hands-on with the craft. We’re open to hiring at Director or Senior Director, depending on scope and experience, with a preference for candidates located in NYC, in a similar time zone, or able to travel.

Why this role matters

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make high-stakes financial decisions with confidence.

In this role, you will set that standard through the AI experience you shape, the team you grow, and the craft bar you hold across the product.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the UX direction for the core AI / agentic experience: a clear, opinionated vision for how analysts work with AI on high-stakes financial decisions, and a sequenced path from today’s product to that north star.
  • Lead through influence and craft: partner with an SVP of Product and multiple PMs (across NY and the UK), advocating for the best experience while working through business goals, timelines, and technical constraints to decide the real first step.
  • Solve the hard, data-dense UX problems: malleable UI with sensible defaults for hedge funds and banks (without overwhelming them), taming information overload, trust and transparency in AI-mediated workflows (citations, confidence, control, reversibility), and cohesion across surfaces.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype in code and with real data, contribute directly to the highest-leverage surfaces, and set the craft bar by doing the work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raise the bar for AI-native design: define how AI shows up as a first-party capability across the product, not just in one agentic pane.
  • Help evolve our foundations: contribute to a design system being rebuilt to be code- and AI-readable.
  • Coach, grow, and care for a small team of senior designers: modeling the craft, giving sharp feedback, and creating the conditions for them to own outcomes end-to-end.
  • Hire and level thoughtfully as the team grows, keeping the org flat and the talent bar high.
  • Multiply the team’s impact through operating mechanisms (UX audits, opportunity maps, product narratives, design reviews, and clear quality bars) rather than personal output alone.
  • Communicate persuasively upward, including to VP/C-level, grounding proposals in customer evidence and business outcomes.

Who You Are:

  • A senior product-design leader with 10+ years of relevant design experience at technical and product-driven companies (3+ years in people management preferred), and a track record of owning a major product area’s experience and shipping it, ideally in complex, data-dense, or expert-user domains.
  • Strong, well-argued opinions held with humility: you shape direction and create healthy friction, and you update your view when the evidence changes.
  • Genuine AI-native product judgment: not just content generation, but designing for trust, control, and workflow transformation in agentic and probabilistic systems.
  • Hands-on craft and technical fluency: comfortable prototyping in code (React / modern front-end an advantage) and using AI tools in your workflow; credible to designers and engineers alike.
  • People leadership: evidence you can model, coach, and care for a team, not only align stakeholders. (For candidates newer to formal management, we’ll look for strong player-coach signals and a real motivation to develop others.)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical partners, and comfort operating in ambiguity across teams.
  • Curiosity about (or experience in) financial services, fintech, or other high-stakes professional domains. Domain expertise is a strong plus; a serious, humble approach to ramping into it is essential.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$224,000—$308,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Sales Development Representative

About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing

These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month.   • Keep HubSpot clean: log every activity, book through the right flow, and make sure every meeting is attributed correctly

  • Review your own calls in Gong, take coaching, and keep improving your messaging

Desired skills & experience

  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling; rejection doesn’t slow you down

  • Aggressive in pursuit of expanding your knowledge & becoming a subject matter expert

  • You own your development: You don’t wait for your manager to find your gaps and help you solve for them. You analyze self performance and spot the areas for growth and build action plans around them.

  • Strong, concise writing: you can write a short, direct email a VP would actually read

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn a new, regulated industry in depth (no technical background required)

  • Organized and process-minded; you see CRM hygiene as part of doing the job well

  • Self-starter who can manage your own schedule in a fully remote environment and asks for help early

  • Coachable: you look for feedback and act on it fast

  • Se

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with HubSpot (CRM and sequences), Gong, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with digital marketing concepts like ad platforms, analytics, or tracking pixels

  • A track record of competing and winning, whether in sales, athletics, or something else

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

jobs.title: Director, Application & AI Security
jobs.description:
Director, Application & AI Security

About Lantern

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Lantern is the specialty care platform, connecting people with high-quality, affordable specialty care close to home. We operate in a regulated healthcare environment (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2), we handle protected health information at scale, and we are becoming an AI healthcare company, with AI adoption a top company priority.

The Director, Application & AI Security owns application and AI security end to end: the security of the software and the AI systems Lantern builds. It is the seat most directly tied to our AI strategy. The job is to make it safe to move fast, building the golden paths and secure defaults that let teams ship product and adopt AI without waiting in a permission queue, while keeping PHI and external-model data egress genuinely protected.

You will lead a growing function. At hire, the team includes a senior application security engineer, with several open roles to fill across security architecture, AI/ML security, DevSecOps, and product security. You will build that team and set the secure-design standards the whole engineering organization builds against.

Our security philosophy is open by default, secure by design. Security exists to help the business move fast, safely, and the default answer is “yes, safely,” because guardrails are built into the platform, pipelines, and tooling rather than enforced by someone saying no. Gates exist only where risk genuinely warrants them, and even then they are automated, fast, and transparent.

Location: Remote

Responsibilities:

  • Own application security across the development lifecycle, covering static, dynamic, and interactive analysis (SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST), code and dependency security, API security, and runtime protections such as WAF and API gateways, all delivered through engineering teams rather than filed as findings.
  • Own AI and ML security, including model and agent security, prompt-injection and tool-use risk, and data-egress controls for third-party model providers, plus continuous AI security posture management informed by the OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and AI risk-management standards (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001).
  • Own security architecture and threat modeling, including secure-by-design review and ownership of cryptographic standards.
  • Own DevSecOps and pipeline security, with scanning as a default in CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, release gating calibrated to risk, and software supply chain and SBOM practice.
  • Own the security-review intake as a single front door with risk-based triage, reported against a turnaround commitment, so security accelerates the business rather than bottlenecking it.
  • Own the application and AI security tool stack and the secure-design standards behind it.

Key Deliverables in Your First Year:

  • An AI golden path: an approved-model catalog and automated data-egress controls, so teams adopt AI on a governed route instead of case-by-case approvals.
  • A secure SDLC paved road, with scanning in the pipeline by default and critical findings resolved within SLA.
  • A single security-review intake that delivers fast, risk-based answers on a published turnaround.
  • A built-out team, with the open roles filled and performing.

How You Will Work:

Much of this scope is delivered in partnership. Engineering carries remediation on application, API, and dependency findings. Platform Engineering operates the CI/CD pipelines you secure. AI Engineering builds the model integrations you govern on the security side, while the Governance, Risk & Compliance team owns AI use governance, meaning acceptable use, model inventory, and third-party model data-egress scoping, as the companion to your security accountability. Setting and holding clear service expectations across these partners is part of the role.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 8 years application or product security.
  • A minimum of 3 years leading a team with function-level accountability.
  • Demonstrated AI and ML security ownership at production scale, including model and agent security, prompt-injection and tool-use risk, and data-egress control for third-party model providers, with working fluency in the OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and AI risk-management standards (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001).
  • Secure SDLC leadership across static, dynamic, and interactive analysis (SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST), dependency and software supply-chain risk, SBOM practice, and remediation delivered through engineering teams.
  • Security architecture and threat-modeling depth, with the standing to review a design and be heard by senior engineers.
  • DevSecOps and pipeline security experience, including scanning as a default in CI/CD, risk-calibrated release gating, and pipeline secret handling.
  • API security experience on a platform handling regulated data.
  • A track record of delivering security as paved roads and secure defaults rather than review gates, with evidence of adoption.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.

Strong Candidates Will:

jobs.description:
Head of Compliance Product

We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.

Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.

You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

  • Lead product for our agentic compliance programme: AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start.

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect.

  • Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways: Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with.

  • Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences.

 
 

What this role is not

  • Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme.

  • Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention.

  • Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems.

 
 

Who we're looking for

  • 10+ years building software products, including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you.

  • A genuine zero-to-one track record: an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on.

  • Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company.

  • Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • AI-native: AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role.

  • Deep executional rigour: you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line.

  • High self-sufficiency: you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn.

  • Continuous systems thinking: you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster.

  • A data-informed operating style: you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees.

  • Judgement under ambiguity: you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist.

  • Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments: you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality.

  • Restlessness about velocity and quality: you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested.

If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you.

Senior Theatre Practitioner- Orthopaedic and Spinal Scrub

The Senior Theatre Practitioner is responsible for delivering high-quality, safe, and efficient perioperative care within the Orthopaedic and Spinal specialties in a private healthcare setting.

As a senior clinician, the post holder will provide expert clinical practice, leadership on shift, and professional support to the wider theatre team. The role includes responsibility for mentoring, supervising, and appraising junior staff and students, supporting compliance with mandatory training and governance requirements, and contributing to the smooth and effective running of theatre services.

The post holder will work collaboratively as part of the multidisciplinary team (MDT) to ensure excellent patient outcomes, efficient use of resources, and a consistently high standard of care in line with organisational values, policies, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

The role is professionally accountable in accordance with the NMC / HCPC Code of Professional Conduct.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality, safe perioperative care within Orthopaedic and Spinal theatres in line with evidence-based practice, national guidance, and organisational policies.

  • Scrub, circulate, or assist as required, maintaining competence and confidence within scope of practice.

  • Ensure all theatre equipment is checked, prepared, and used safely prior to each list, escalating and reporting faults immediately.

  • Maintain accurate, contemporaneous documentation in line with hospital policy and professional standards.

  • Uphold the highest standards of infection prevention and control, including aseptic technique, dress code compliance, and maintenance of a clean working environment.

  • Safely handle, store, and administer medicines in accordance with hospital policy.

  • Participate in the on-call rota and support emergency activity as required.

  • Maintain and develop clinical knowledge and skills through ongoing CPD.

Leadership, Supervision & Appraisal

  • Act as a senior practitioner on shift, supporting coordination of theatre activity to ensure safe, efficient operating lists.

  • Deputise for the Lead Practitioner when required, ensuring appropriate staffing, skill mix, and equipment availability.

  • Provide day-to-day supervision, guidance, and clinical leadership to junior staff, students, bank, and agency colleagues.

  • Undertake appraisals for allocated junior staff in line with organisational appraisal frameworks and timelines.

  • Act as a mentor / practice assessor, supporting students and new starters to achieve clinical competencies and professional development goals.

  • Support staff wellbeing, performance, and development, escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Promote a positive, inclusive, and professional working environment.

MDT Working & Team Support

  • Work cohesively and collaboratively with surgeons, anaesthetists, recovery staff, ward teams, and other departments to ensure seamless patient pathways.

  • Actively support the wider theatre and perioperative team during periods of high activity or service pressure.

  • Promote effective communication, mutual respect, and shared accountability within the MDT.

  • Contribute to a culture of teamwork, patient-centred care, and continuous improvement across the service.

 

Operational & Resource Management

  • Support the effective and efficient use of theatre resources, including consumables and equipment.

  • Ensure accurate use of electronic systems for patient management, theatre documentation, and stock capture.

  • Assist with stock checks and escalate shortages or issues appropriately.

  • Adjust practice in response to emergency cases, staffing shortages, or changes to theatre lists to maintain service delivery.

  • Report equipment failures in line with policy and liaise with senior staff to support timely resolution.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Maintain 100% compliance with mandatory training requirements, professional registration, and revalidation.

  • Adhere at all times to organisational policies, procedures, and SOPs, and actively promote compliance within the team.

  • Work in accordance with NICE guidance, NatSSIPs, LocSSIPs, NCEPOD, and other relevant national standards.

  • Ensure incidents, near misses, and concerns are reported promptly and accurately.

  • Participate in audits, quality improvement initiatives, and implementation of action plans.

  • Contribute to incident investigations and learning reviews as required.

  • Maintain confidentiality and data protection standards in line with GDPR and organisational policy.

Communication & Professional Practice

  • Communicate effectively and professionally with patients, relatives, and colleagues.

  • Ensure clear, timely handovers and documentation to support continuity and safety of care.

  • Escalate clinical, operational, or staffing concerns appropriately.

  • Act as a professional role model, demonstrating accountability, integrity, and leadership by example.

  • Participate fully in appraisal, supervision, and professional development processes.


Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  

  • Registered Practitioner with NMC or HCPC registration.

  • Minimum of 4 years post-qualification experience within an operating theatre environment.

  • Significant experience within Orthopaedic and/or Spinal theatres. 

  • Educated to degree level or equivalent relevant experience 

  • Proven ability to act as a senior clinician and support coordination of theatre activity 

  • Experience supervising and supporting junior staff, students, and new starters

  • Evidence of ongoing Continuous Professional Development (CPD) 

  • ILS qualification

  • Commitment to full compliance with mandatory training, policies, and SOPs.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Qualified Surgical First Assistant

  • Mentorship / Practice Assessor qualification.

  • ALS qualification 

  • Experience undertaking staff appraisals 

  • Experience contributing to service or quality improvement initiatives within theatres

Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.
Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager
Job Type: Contract - USA

Job Description

About This Role

Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences.

We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top.

This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below).

Role & Responsibilities

As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice.

You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems.

Â 

Key Responsibilities

Search & AEO Strategy Leadership

  • Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth.

  • Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries.

  • Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence.

  • Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices.

AI & Emerging Search Optimization

  • Develop structured data and schema strategies to enhance visibility in rich results, AI summaries, and enhanced SERP features.

  • Stand up and manage AI-visibility monitoring using a dedicated citation-tracking platform â track share of AI citations, sentiment, and source attribution across client brands and named competitors.

  • Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage.

  • Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact.

Technical & Content SEO Execution

  • Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits.

  • Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates.

  • Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies.

  • Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building.

Cross-Functional & Client Collaboration

  • Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes.

  • Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives.

Data, Measurement & Automation

  • Leverage automation tools, APIs, AI workflows, and scripting (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script, or SQL) to improve efficiency and scalability. ~~advanced Excel or scripting capabilities~~

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â 
Join Secure Code Warrior and help us in our mission to create a safer digital landscape. Weâre empowering organizations to secure their softwareâno matter how the code is written!

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Creative Director
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

  • Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
  • Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
  • By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

A brand system that morphs

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
  • Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

The team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
  • Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
  • A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
  • Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate
Â 
The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
Â 
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Â 
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
Â 
More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Â 
Luxury Presence has earned a spot on BuiltInâs Best Places to Work list every year since 2020. Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and weâve won multiple Tech100 Awards. Inman has also honored us twice: with the 2025 Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform and the 2026 title of Best Proptech Company.
Â

Account Director (Network Testing & Planning)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director (Network Testing & Planning) based in the United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.

Accountabilities:

Take full ownership of territory revenue targets, sales pipeline development, and forecasting across the UK, Ireland, and assigned strategic European accounts. Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans aligned with business growth objectives and commercial priorities. Expand existing strategic customer relationships through account penetration, upselling, cross-selling, and the development of new business opportunities. Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers across the mobile network testing, planning, optimisation, and broader telecommunications ecosystem. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders within target accounts. Understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, and operational requirements, translating them into compelling commercial opportunities and tailored value propositions. Develop robust business cases demonstrating measurable customer benefits, supporting larger-scale engagements and long-term partnerships. Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting, qualification, and discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract closure. Identify competitive displacement opportunities and position alternative network testing and planning solutions to increase market share. Explore new market segments and addressable opportunities, including private networks, neutral hosts, infrastructure providers, engineering service companies, and adjacent telecommunications markets. Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and channel relationships to strengthen market coverage and create additional routes to market. Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams on technical qualification, product demonstrations, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance. Strengthen customer and partner relationships to generate repeat business, increase engagement value, and establish sustainable revenue streams.

Requirements:

Demonstrated success in B2B technology sales, with a proven track record of managing and achieving revenue targets and sales quotas. Significant experience selling to telecommunications operators, network equipment vendors, or organisations operating within the broader mobile network ecosystem. Knowledge Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States.

The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

Benefits:

High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Opportunity to develop and implement innovative solutions that improve employee productivity and customer experiences. jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.
